What story will you write?

But when the Idol Demon King throws a live concert, a massive wave of hyped-up monsters stampedes straight toward your village!
2860490.name: Warota: I Live Next to The Demon King's Castle LOL

2861080.desc: A cozy and spooky co-op adventure where two puppies rescue their owner from a haunted mansion. Customize your puppy, solve puzzles together, and defeat evil creatures. Play locally or invite a friend for free with Friend’s Pass.

2868840.desc: The iconic roguelike deckbuilder returns. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, and discover relics of immense power in Slay the Spire 2!

2870790.name: Dumpster Gang

2873440.desc: Chrono Odyssey, A Next-generation Action MMORPG. Game features include awe-inspiring visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, a vast and intricately designed seamless open world, dynamic action-based combat mechanics based on time manipulation and extensive customization.
2873440.name: Chrono Odyssey

2873750.desc: A horror pool roguelite with upgradable cues, guns and procedural rituals. Shoot some balls. Unleash horrors from beyond. Go insane. Try again.

291550.desc: An epic platform fighter for up to 8 players online or local. Try casual free-for-alls, ranked matches, or invite friends to a private room. And it's free! Play cross-platform with millions of players on PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, iOS, Android & Steam! Frequent updates. Over sixty Legends.
291550.name: Brawlhalla

292030.desc: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered modernizes the acclaimed role-playing game with a range of upgrades and enhancements. Become monster slayer for hire Geralt of Rivia and journey across a dark fantasy open world in an epic quest to find your adopted daughter Ciri.
292030.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered

2924520.desc: A sci-fi mystery set on the repurposed moon hotel Samsara. Uncover cryptic experiments, face unsettling encounters, and piece together a mind-bending narrative. The deeper you go, the more the truth unravels as you confront the ultimate question: What is reality?
2924520.name: ONTOS

294100.desc: A sci-fi colony sim driven by an intelligent AI storyteller. Generates stories by simulating psychology, ecology, gunplay, melee combat, climate, biomes, diplomacy, interpersonal relationships, art, medicine, trade, and more.
294100.name: RimWorld

2944770.desc: A retro jRPG with a twist. Have you heard the one about the million dollars and the immortal snail? A Snail's Tale will let you play out the story and answer the question once and for all - can he be stopped?
2944770.name: A Snail's Tale

2953940.desc: Relive the epic battles between Spartans, Persians, and Egyptians in Ancient Wars: Sparta HD. Enjoy HD graphics, asymmetric civilizations, enhanced campaigns, new maps, smarter AI, and a revamped multiplayer mode. Forge your empire, master warfare, and make history in the Ancient World!
2953940.name: Ancient Wars: Sparta HD

2956040.desc: Operate your planetary defense cannon to fend off an interplanetary invasion from the comfort of your cozy bunker. You’re here to stay, so obey your superiors, press the right buttons, and sip your daily tea ration - it's good for you.
2956040.name: PVKK: Planetenverteidigungskanonenkommandant

2963950.desc: Step into a Supernatural Turn-Based RPG Adventure Solve Mysteries, Strengthen Bonds, and Awaken Your Persona
2963950.name: Persona 4 Revival

2967590.desc: A surreal story-driven game that uses puzzle-solving, Guitar Hero-esque battles, and open world navigation to help Van Cat track down his evil uncle and put an end to his nefarious plans!
2967590.name: Vanakatu

2988120.desc: Never Be Alone is an open-world zombie survival game for solo play and seamless co-op. Explore a world reclaimed by nature, protect a fragile safezone, and uncover the truth behind your forgotten past 10 years after the outbreak.
2988120.name: Never Be Alone

2990.desc: Experience the drive of your life as you throw yourself around on and off the track causing fences to shatter, tyre walls explode, water tanks and barrels fly across the track into other cars.
2990.name: FlatOut 2

2991650.desc: Dawn is an animated film that plunges you into the heart of a dark story. A fighter pilot, ready to do anything for revenge. An explosive cocktail of dogfights, epic music and a gripping story.
2991650.name: DAWN AEROWAR

30.desc: Enlist in an intense brand of Axis vs. Allied teamplay set in the WWII European Theatre of Operations. Players assume the role of light/assault/heavy infantry, sniper or machine-gunner class, each with a unique arsenal of historical weaponry at their disposal. Missions are based on key historical operations.
30.name: Day of Defeat

300.desc: Valve's WWII Multiplayer Classic - Now available for Mac.
300.name: Day of Defeat: Source

3005700.desc: Take on the role of a lighthouse keeper on a remote island. Maintain the machinery, use the radio and the map to guide ships into the harbor. Survive and uncover the mysteries of Farpoint Island in a horror experience inspired by Voices of the Void and No One Lives Under the Lighthouse.
3005700.name: The last keeper

3010300.desc: A compact 2.5D pixel-art, turn-based JRPG designed to be completed in about an hour. Train as a hero, explore White Mountain, learn new skills, collect gear, and fight beside your companion on the road to the Dragon King.
3010300.name: One-Hour Hero

3014860.desc: The legendary jumping game is back! Join Harold the Homeboy and friends as they jump up the Icy Tower. Make combo jumps to build up massive scores. How high can you get?
3014860.name: Icy Tower

3016620.desc: Alkahest is an Action-Adventure RPG set in a murky medieval world. Where satisfying melee combat with highly interactive environments takes center stage. Explore realistic locations, learn alchemy and make a name for your family.
3016620.name: Alkahest

3020.desc: Call of Juarez is an epic adventure western themed FPS game. The player alternately assumes the roles of two distinct, antagonistic characters: a sneaking fugitive Billy and his hunter the reverend Ray.
3020.name: Call of Juarez

3030560.desc: Sloppy Forgeries is a fast-paced competitive painting game. Practice your skills by butchering iconic masterpieces in one of the few drawing games that measures accuracy pixel-by-pixel in real-time.
3030560.name: Sloppy Forgeries

304050.desc: Grab your friends, hone your blades, and set off for an epic procedurally generated adventure in Trove! Battle the Shadow in realms filled with dungeons and items created by your fellow players. Whether hunting treasure or building realms of your own, it’s never been this good to be square!
304050.name: Trove

3041640.desc: Shadey’s Quest is an autobattler roguelike featuring character building. Shadey is a monster who wants to be a hero, but the only thing he is good at is eating. Guide him through a rich fantasy world, feed and equip him, and help him defeat the fearsome King of Shadows!
3041640.name: Shadey's Quest

3042040.desc: Join Oakley and Elmer on their whimsical adventure through a stunning archipelago filled with people to befriend and secrets to uncover. Though simply tasked with finding a strange mythical creature, the two robots are distracted by the beauty of the islands.
3042040.name: Project: Autumn

304930.desc: Unturned is an open-world zombie survival sandbox game. As one of the few not yet turned, you must fight to remain among the living.
304930.name: Unturned

3073940.desc: Judgment Day has come to medieval Birmingham, and a plague of flesh-hungry ghouls has claimed every living soul… except one. Fight to survive in a highly tactile, physics-based survival sim where every object can be manipulated. Make ends meet, or meet your end.
3073940.name: God Save Birmingham

3078150.desc: Former developers from Bethesda, BioWare, and Naughty Dog bring you the sandbox RPG realm of anthropomorphic animals and fairy creatures. This early Proof-of-Concept Demo is an intentional look back at where Hawthorn's development journey began and an invitation to shape the future of Hawthorn!
3078150.name: Hawthorn

3103620.desc: Witch the Showdown is a high-difficulty parry-action game where every battle is a boss fight. Build mana through precise parries, then unleash attacks in real time using your cards—this unique combat system defines the experience.
3103620.name: Witch the Showdown

3111050.desc: Investigate a disappearance in a quiet American suburb in 1997. Spend the night exploring the early internet and following a digital trail in this first-person mystery-horror experience.
3111050.name: Secrets Of Suburbia

3119210.desc: Growth is a cozy farming automation game where you turn a small farm into a growing production network. Plant crops, collect resources, process items, connect machines with conveyors, complete orders, and explore the world with your loyal dog by your side.
3119210.name: Growth: Automate & Collect

3130.desc: Red Tide blends deep RTS tactics with the raw intensity of third-person combat. Created in collaboration with author Alexander Zorich, this standalone expansion tells the story of the Black Coats – Soviet Naval Infantry famed for their ruthless precision in the Black Sea campaigns.
3130.name: Men of War: Red Tide

3161310.desc: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine.
3161310.name: Hela: of Mice & Magic

3164500.desc: From small-time dope pusher to kingpin - manufacture and distribute a range of drugs throughout the grungy city of Hyland Point. Expand your empire with properties, businesses, employees and more.
3164500.name: Schedule I

3170.desc: King’s Bounty: Armored Princess builds on the foundation of The Legend, expanding the classic formula with deeper turn-based tactics, a huge hand-crafted world, and new mechanics that change how you approach battles and progression.
3170.name: King's Bounty: Armored Princess

3177710.desc: In a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies, your only sanctuary is a moving train. Build it into a powerful fortress, gather resources, and survive relentless challenges. Play solo or CO-OP, defend against zombie attacks, endure harsh survival conditions, and face this perilous journey together.
3177710.name: On The Train

3188660.desc: A hyper-realistic motocross simulator built by riders, for riders. Control bike and rider as two separate physics bodies, race online through matchmaking or private lobbies, and chase the clock on live global time-attack leaderboards. Assists let newcomers learn at their own pace.
3188660.name: Motocross The Game

3199530.desc: A dark fantasy auto battler with loot hunting and idle rewards. Combine gear, affixes and relics into hero builds. Field four heroes with reserves ready to take over. Earn offline rewards, forge mythic gear and push through new cycles, Boss Rush and the endgame boss.
3199530.name: Dark Ruins: Nine Dragons Pulling the Coffin

320.desc: Fast multiplayer action set in the Half-Life 2 universe! HL2's physics adds a new dimension to deathmatch play. Play straight deathmatch or try Combine vs. Resistance teamplay. Toss a toilet at your friend today!
320.name: Half-Life 2: Deathmatch

3214180.desc: Isekai survivors is an Action roguelite with RPG elements and addictive gameplay loop, cute stylized art style and attractive heroines with unique playstyles to choose from. Collect items, complete quests, upgrade your stats and learn new powerful spells to dominate the battlefield.
3214180.name: Isekai Survivors

3218350.desc: Embark on a brand-new RuneScape idle adventure with Melvor Idle 2. Master iconic RuneScape Skills, face powerful Combat challenges, or uncover the history of the world via Quests, all while enjoying zen-like progression.
3218350.name: Melvor Idle 2

3218570.desc: The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!
3218570.name: TANUKI: Pon's Summer

322170.desc: Jump and fly your way through danger in this rhythm-based action platformer!
322170.name: Geometry Dash

322330.desc: Fight, Farm, Build and Explore Together in the standalone multiplayer expansion to the uncompromising wilderness survival game, Don't Starve.
322330.name: Don't Starve Together

3224600.desc: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.
3224600.name: Am I Nima

3224770.desc: Umamusume: Pretty Derby, winner of Best Mobile Game at The Game Awards 2025, is ready to race! Scout featured trainees and supporters as you navigate the immersive sports life simulation through the game's in-depth training system and top-of-the-line 3D graphics!
3224770.name: Umamusume: Pretty Derby

3230960.desc: Step forward into EXODUS™ — a cinematic, single-player action RPG set in a new, far-future sci-fi universe. Rise from salvager to Traveler, discover new worlds ravaged by the effects of time, and search for the key to humanity’s survival across the most dangerous reaches of space.
3230960.name: EXODUS

32370.desc: It is four thousand years before the Galactic Empire and hundreds of Jedi Knights have fallen in battle against the ruthless Sith. You are the last hope of the Jedi Order. Can you master the awesome power of the Force on your quest to save the Republic? Or will you fall to the lure of the dark side?
32370.name: STAR WARS™ Knights of the Old Republic™

3239710.desc: The Red Cathedral is a fun turn-based strategy game for 1 to 4 players. Manage your resources well to build the cathedral better than anyone else and thus win the Tsar's favor.
3239710.name: The Red Cathedral

3240220.desc: Experience entertainment blockbusters Grand Theft Auto V and Grand Theft Auto Online — now upgraded for a new generation with stunning visuals, faster loading, 3D audio, and more, plus exclusive content for GTA Online players.
3240220.name: Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced

3241660.desc: An online co-op horror game with up to 6 players. Locate valuable, fully physics-based objects and handle them with care as you retrieve and extract to satisfy your creator's desires.
3241660.name: R.E.P.O.

32440.desc: Kick Some Brick in I through VI! Play through all six Star Wars movies in one videogame! Adding new characters, new levels, new features and for the first time ever, the chance to build and battle your way through a fun Star Wars galaxy on your PC!
32440.name: LEGO® Star Wars™ - The Complete Saga

32470.desc: Command or corrupt an entire galaxy in the definitive Star Wars strategy collection. It is a time of galactic civil war. Will you take up the reins of the Rebellion, assume control of the Empire, or rule the Star Wars Underworld?
32470.name: STAR WARS™ Empire at War - Gold Pack

3255110.desc: Grave Seasons is a narrative farming sim with a terrifying twist – someone in the town is a supernatural serial killer. Farm, romance, and investigate your way through the unsettling town of Ashenridge.
3255110.name: Grave Seasons

3281420.desc: PARADISE is a free-to-play life simulation game with limitless possibilities, realistic graphics, and advanced AI. Endless World, Endless Play.
3281420.name: Paradise

3283240.desc: You are a handyman renovating a massive research facility abandoned after a mysterious incident. The Lift is an eerie first-person simulator with satisfying house-flipping gameplay, a mind-bending story, and a highly interactive world inspired by Soviet sci-fi and the SCP Foundation.
3283240.name: THE LIFT: Supernatural Handyman Simulator

3285880.desc: In MONOMOON, the way forward is reserved for the knowing and the daring. Guided by moonlight, you’ll uncover hidden truths and wander through a tiny and mysterious open world.
3285880.name: MONOMOON

3292470.desc: Tides of Annihilation is an action-adventure game steeped in the legends of King Arthur. When an otherworldly invasion shatters London, Gwendolyn, a lone survivor, embarks on a desperate quest to fight back and uncover the truth that lies beyond the veil.
3292470.name: Tides of Annihilation

3305190.desc: Feed your fellow Shape Buddies to a bizarre cast of Glutton Monsters before they put you on the menu. Catch, balance and fling food with absurd, anything-but-proper plates — solo, or 2 players on one PC or via Steam Remote Play Together. Everything obeys physics; nothing obeys you.
3305190.name: One More Plate!

3320.desc: The craziest aquarium game ever! Tend to your fish, keep them happy and they'll reward you with coins and jewels. Buy tank upgrades or egg parts which hatch different in-tank pets. These pets can help you feed your fish, collect coins, or even protect against the aliens that will invade your tank.
3320.name: Insaniquarium Deluxe

3321460.desc: Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure set on the continent of Pywel. Join Kliff on his journey to rebuild the Greymane faction and to save the land from a looming threat. From vast wilderness and cities to ruins and the mysterious Abyss, forge your path through battles and discovery.
3321460.name: Crimson Desert Enhanced

33230.desc: An epic story of family, vengeance and conspiracy set in the pristine, yet brutal, backdrop of a Renaissance Italy. New low price!
33230.name: Assassin's Creed 2

3330.desc: Deep in the jungle lie hidden temples bursting with traps and trickery, and it's up to you to uncover their treasures. Fire magical balls from your stone frog idol to make matches of three or more and clear the deadly chain before it reaches the golden skull.
3330.name: Zuma Deluxe

3337850.desc: Delve into KYORA, a mystical multiplayer sandbox adventure, where every pixel is yours to shape, mine, build or explode.
3337850.name: KYORA

3366370.desc: Explore, fight, and SMUSH in this hand-drawn roguelite first person adventure! Descend a magical bunker filled with wild biomes, master magical tools, manage your fear gauge, overcome hazards, combat spooky enemies, and cause co-op chaos.
3366370.name: UnderMire

3371050.desc: Welcome to Zeverland, survive & craft together with your friends in a deceptively cute apocalypse, with no limits! Everything is interactive like the real world—dismantle toilets, strap zombie heads to bats, or weld a bed to your RV. Then, try to repair bridges, make vaccines, and relight the world!
3371050.name: Zeverland

3376710.desc: Hunt raccoons and feed them to your pet.
3376710.name: Raccoon Hunter

33930.desc: Three years after the conflict in Chernarus, portrayed in the original Arma 2, a new flashpoint explodes in the Green Sea Region. Coalition forces led by the US Army are deployed to Takistan to quickly restore peace and prevent further civilian casualties.
33930.name: Arma 2: Operation Arrowhead

3393110.desc: AION 2 is the only MMORPG built around a world where the sky is the battlefield. Choose your faction, ascend as a Daeva, and fight a faction war across a world 36 times larger than the original. PC only, on Unreal Engine 5.
3393110.name: AION 2

340.desc: Originally planned as a section of the Highway 17 chapter of Half-Life 2, Lost Coast is a playable technology showcase that introduces High Dynamic Range lighting to the Source engine.
340.name: Half-Life 2: Lost Coast

34030.desc: Complete your Total War collection with this Definitive Edition of Total War: NAPOLEON, which includes all DLC and feature updates since the game’s release
34030.name: Total War: NAPOLEON – Definitive Edition

3404030.desc: CLOGWORK is a factory automation game. Cut, glue and rotate pieces into the shapes you need. Build conveyor belts and logic circuits, prevent jams, and deliver finished shapes to the Hub. Build in 2D, or switch to 3D at any time.
3404030.name: Clogwork

3405690.desc: Experience The World's Game like never before in EA SPORTS FC™ 26. Go for glory in a 48-team international tournament mode, take on themed Manager Live Challenges, and step into Player Career with new international ICONs and Heroes.
3405690.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 26

3419430.desc: Bongo cat needs your help. Bongo cat needz more hatz!!! Every time you press a key, Bongo cat will punch your taskbar. Type, click, play, work to collect more points. Which hats will you find?
3419430.name: Bongo Cat

3433110.desc: Tycoon game where you manage your movie theater through more than 100 years of history. Build and customize your cinematic empire without being overtaken by the evolution of the 7th art.
3433110.name: Cinema Theater Tycoon

3435580.desc: Noir Total is a 2D local multiplayer PvP shooter set in darkened arenas. Sneak through total darkness using your controller’s vibrations, track down your enemies, collect bonuses and set traps to stay one step ahead of your opponents in fast-paced, competitive matches for up to 4 players.
3435580.name: Noir Total : Deadly Party

346110.desc: Stranded on the shores of a mysterious island, you must learn to survive. Use your cunning to kill or tame the primeval creatures roaming the land, and encounter other players to survive, dominate... and escape!
346110.name: ARK: Survival Evolved

3475680.desc: You drive left. They drive right. Straight? Only if you're both on the same page. Shared RC splits control of one car between two players — team up (or don't) across brutal, physics-based courses where every wrong move is somebody else's fault too.
3475680.name: Shared RC

3480.desc: Take your best shot with energizing arcade fun! Aim, shoot, clear the orange pegs, then sit back and cheer as 10 whimsical teachers guide you to Peggle greatness.
3480.name: Peggle Deluxe

3483.desc: Peggle Extreme delivers fast-paced puzzle action that combines elements of pinball and pachinko to create a truly unique game experience. Take your best shot with energizing arcade fun, now exclusively themed with art and sounds from Half-Life: Episode 2, Portal, and Team Fortress 2.
3483.name: Peggle Extreme

34870.desc: Sniper: Ghost Warrior 2 takes the bulls-eye precision of its predecessor to new and exciting heights!
34870.name: Sniper: Ghost Warrior 2

34900.desc: Bad Rats is a physics puzzle game where rats finally get their bloody revenge on their new prisoners: The cats. Come up with creative solutions for each puzzle using physics, functional objects, and your specially trained Rats. Try different ways of solving each puzzle to finish faster or earn higher scores.
34900.name: Bad Rats: the Rats' Revenge

3499790.desc: In this massive RTS game, command vast armies fighting for control of entire worlds. Control the forces of Earth, the mechanical AI Substrate, or the enigmatic Post-Human Coalition as you battle across the solar system in single player, cooperative multiplayer, or competitive multiplayer.
3499790.name: Ashes of the Singularity II

3504050.desc: A disappearance in a secluded community. A mountain hiding its secrets. A detective running out of time. Welcome to Hillthorn, a dark investigation game that invites you to uncover the mystery without a single word spoken, using your skills of logic and intuition through cards.
3504050.name: Hillthorn

3513350.desc: Wuthering Waves is a story-rich open-world action RPG with a high degree of freedom. You wake from your slumber as Rover, joined by a vibrant cast of Resonators on a journey to reclaim your lost memories and change the world.
3513350.name: Wuthering Waves

3517740.desc: Through the frost, death follows the tracks. Dive into a ruthless survival FPS, solo or co-op. Explore, scavenge, craft and fight to endure a frozen, corrupted world. Operate and upgrade your steam-powered train through an unforgiving wasteland, where every choice is a matter of survival.
3517740.name: Frostrail

3527290.desc: PEAK is a co-op climbing game where the slightest mistake can spell your doom. Either solo or as a group of lost nature scouts, your only hope of rescue from a mysterious island is to scale the mountain at its center. Do you have what it takes to reach the PEAK?
3527290.name: PEAK

3549030.desc: Explore dungeons in a single-player, turn-based RPG. Learn skills across classes, craft gear with your choice of materials, and lead a party of up to five against bosses. Develop your village and build bonds with your companions.
3549030.name: Heavensmith: Dungeon Unbound

3551820.desc: Fight hordes of evil monsters and defend your castle in this 1-4 player action platformer with Roguelike elements!
3551820.name: Castlebound

3558670.desc: Experience a stunning reimagining of Lara Croft’s debut adventure to discover the lost secrets of Atlantis with jaw-dropping visuals, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.
3558670.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis

3570680.desc: Meltdown is a nuclear reactor desk-job simulation where you, as a newly recruited operator, must control the reactor to keep the surrounding city powered up. Maintain the wires in the power grid, regulate the water tank’s flow, and tune the steam ventilation to keep the reactor from overheating.
3570680.name: Meltdown

3590.desc: Zombies are invading your home, and the only defense is your arsenal of plants! Armed with an alien nursery-worth of zombie-zapping plants like peashooters and cherry bombs, you'll need to think fast and plant faster to stop dozens of types of zombies dead in their tracks.
3590.name: Plants vs. Zombies GOTY Edition

359550.desc: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege is an elite, tactical team-based shooter where superior planning and execution triumph.
359550.name: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege

360.desc: Half-Life Deathmatch: Source is a recreation of the first multiplayer game set in the Half-Life universe. Features all the classic weapons and most-played maps, now running on the Source engine.
360.name: Half-Life Deathmatch: Source

3610790.desc: 17-year-old Hope Song thought the national exams were her biggest worry... until she got home to a ransacked apartment and two missing parents. Investigate through the eyes of an artist, turn sketches into evidence, and watch her family's mystery grow stranger and darker with every answer.
3610790.name: Hope in the City

3618480.desc: Follow in the footsteps of a missing Egyptologist as you explore mysterious passageways beneath the Great Pyramids. Solve 50 unique and challenging puzzles, uncover ancient artifacts, and discover the truth behind his disappearance.
3618480.name: Journey Under The Pyramids

3629430.desc: DREADMOOR is a dark first-person fishing adventure game set in a submerged world, rotting from a past catastrophe. Fish in murky waters, upgrade your boat, craft survival gear, and fight monstrous creatures that lurk under the water and on the land.
3629430.name: DREADMOOR

3642910.desc: Embark on bite-sized campaigns in this co-op action RPG set in a rustic fantasy world. Start from nothing, and freely build your character as you investigate rumors, explore strange ruins, and survive the dangers threatening the fallen Kingdom of Caerwyn.
3642910.name: Wyldheart

3669200.desc: A PvE roguelike autobattler with no timers, no queue and no PvP. Draft a guild, rank heroes from C to S and stack 300+ relics into builds that one-shot bosses. Climb 8 difficulties and the Endless leaderboards. Start small, become unstoppable.
3669200.name: Guildrun

3669620.desc: Warhammer Survivors is the official grim and dark bullet-heaven game from the developers of Warhammer 40,000 Boltgun. Play as over 40 iconic champions from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes and obliterate those who champion death and destruction.
3669620.name: Warhammer Survivors

3677850.desc: Explore a mysterious hot springs in the dead of night and meet the other lost souls who are drawn to this place.
3677850.name: Springs, Eternal

3678970.desc: The ultimate tiny idle RPG! Adorable pixel heroes are waiting to join your adventure — from your taskbar. Fight off the boredom of work and daily life with diverse classes, skills, items, and builds!
3678970.name: TBH: Task Bar Hero

3680170.desc: A round-based co-op zombies FPS for 1 to 4 players. Survive endless hordes in brutalist procedurally generated map. Buy doors, hit the mystery box, upgrade your guns, and uncover the hidden ritual that wakes the Mother.
3680170.name: Mortuus

3681220.desc: The shadow wants to play with you. It moves quickly, and you have to find it. Be patient, but don't wait too long. Light will be your friend. Don't make the shadow angry.
3681220.name: The Light Switch

3687090.desc: Dice Hoarder is a cozy organizing game where you restock a mysterious dice shop. Sort every die in the shop, match them into complete seven-piece sets, and uncover what is hidden behind your new job.
3687090.name: Dice Hoarder

3699850.desc: You lost your soul in a poker game against the Devil. Now, trapped in the infernal depths, your only hope is to fight your way back to freedom. You’ll face a diverse gallery of monstrous foes in nearly impossible poker battles - but luckily, you’re a cheater.
3699850.name: The Devil's Due

3700360.desc: Betrayed, broke, and packing twin magic hand cannons, ex-noble Alice is fighting to survive with her one-armed butler in a ruthless world where the strong rule the weak. A dark fantasy JRPG with full voice acting, nostalgic doujin-style visuals, and 20+ hours of story-driven adventure.
3700360.name: Princessfall

3710120.desc: Brew potions, compete with fellow alchemists, and save the magical world from destruction in the digital adaptation of the beloved board game.
3710120.name: Potion-making: Path of the Alchemist

3710600.desc: Become an acolyte of the Inquisition in this grim dark, party-based, story-driven cRPG. Lead investigations, uncover grand conspiracies, master tactical combat, and wage a secret war against heresy. Make tough choices as a conduit of the God-Emperor’s will.
3710600.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy

3714800.desc: Play as Kaatri in Warlock, a single-player, third-person action-adventure set in a D&D-inspired open world. Wield forbidden magic to bend the rules around you. Across exploration and combat, every challenge is a test of creativity, preparation, and cunning.
3714800.name: Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons

3721530.desc: Buy rusty motorcycles, restore every part, add custom paint and decals, then take them for a test ride and sell them for a profit. Turn barn finds into superbikes and grow your small garage into the best dealership in town.
3721530.name: Motorcycle For Sale Simulator

3722820.desc: A lightning strike, a torch in your hands, and a voice echoes: “Your fates are now bound.” Tied together by a fragile rope — if it snaps, the fall is inevitable. Jump, climb, solve, slide… but never lose your rhythm. Only the patient will glimpse the summit.
3722820.name: Onlympic Up!

3724300.desc: Toto’s Journey is a cozy adventure inspired by the world of The Wizard of Oz. Play as Toto, a brave dog lost in a magical world after a mysterious cyclone. Explore enchanted lands, meet unusual creatures, and solve environmental puzzles as you search for a way back home.
3724300.name: Toto's Journey

3727390.desc: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is a third-person Action RPG set in The Expanse universe. You’re no hero — just a merc caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, trying to hold your crew together and keep the ship up and running. Your choices will shape your story.
3727390.name: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn

3769420.desc: Zombie wave survival meets King of the hill. Survive, Upgrade, and Protect your flag. Face the unexpected through special rounds, endure the constantly growing horde, and customize your loadout. How many rounds will you survive?
3769420.name: Hill-Z

377160.desc: From Bethesda Game Studios, the award-winning creators of Starfield and The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim, comes Fallout 4. A landmark in open-world RPG design and winner of over 200 ‘Best Of’ honors, including the DICE and BAFTA Game of the Year.
377160.name: Fallout 4

3788800.desc: The Atomic Heart sequel brings you back to the retrofuturistic universe, full of new characters and dangers. The game immerses you in events on a global scale and raises the bar for what an open-world action RPG can do.
3788800.name: Atomic Heart 2

3796990.desc: Explore the Land of Fire and Ice! Iceland stands apart as one of the most extraordinary countries on Earth, an incredibly unique landscape with completely unmatched rugged nature. Now, you have the chance to experience it all from a truly unique perspective - behind the wheel of your truck.
3796990.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - Iceland

3801210.desc: Defend a dying world and bring it back to life as you play. Grow spirit trees to defeat enemies, releasing energy that spreads across the land, restoring the forest in real time as you push back a world-consuming blight.
3801210.name: Rebirth TD

3809270.desc: Trade cargo for passengers in a whole new ETS2 journey! Take a seat behind the wheel – not of a truck, but of a coach. The Coaches DLC brings a new dimension to the ETS2 experience by introducing scheduled passenger transport across Europe.
3809270.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - Coaches

3810510.desc: DERELIKT is a narrative retro FPS built for fans of claustrophobic PS1-era sci-fi horror.
3810510.name: DERELIKT

3810960.desc: Like Pacman, but the roles are reversed! Command a squad of officers and corner the bad guys before they make off with their stash! Use your mouse and keyboard to order the officers to pinch the criminals before time runs out!
3810960.name: Sting Operation

381210.desc: 10 years of horror. 10 years of jump scares and close calls. 10 years of brutal sacrifices and thrilling escapes. Trapped forever in a realm of eldritch evil where even death is not an escape, four determined Survivors face a bloodthirsty Killer in a vicious game of nerve and wits.
381210.name: Dead by Daylight

3814550.desc: Hi, I’m Jessica, and welcome to Brothel Hotel! This pixel art management game for adults puts you in charge of an exclusive brothel. Your mission? Oversee every aspect of the business, ensure smooth operations, and fulfill the desires of an ever-demanding clientele.
3814550.name: Brothel Hotel

3816120.desc: Interactive movie‑game blending SLG gameplay and real‑life romance simulation: Step into the shoes of an underdog and live out a power‑fantasy rags‑to‑riches story. Combat, character progression, drinking and romance — all in one! 100‑GB content volume- redefines your power‑fantasy experience!
3816120.name: Re2 I Rise Alone

3830.desc: A Psychic Odyssey Through the Minds of Misfits, Monsters, and Madmen. This classic action/adventure platformer from acclaimed developers Double Fine Productions follows the story of a young psychic named Razputin.
3830.name: Psychonauts

3830080.desc: Embark on a Dark Fantasy odyssey in Twilight Requiem, an action RPG blending heart-pounding combat and mystical exploration. Wield cosmic powers, master fluid combos inspired by Kingdom Hearts 2 Final Mix, and traverse haunting realms through enigmatic portals.
3830080.name: Twilight Requiem

3850230.desc: A fast-paced co-op zombie survival action game where players fight through hordes of enemies, unlock random power-ups, build different synergies, and escape together as a team.
3850230.name: 99Day Survival Guide

386360.desc: Join 40+ million players in SMITE, the Battleground of the Gods! Wield Thor’s hammer, turn your foes to stone as Medusa, or flex your divine power as one of 100+ other mythological icons. Become a God and play FREE today!
386360.name: SMITE®

3864580.desc: P.O.N. is a co-op superhero horror game where you're just another low-level thug in the criminal underworld. Justice never sleeps. Stick together, watch each other's backs, or be trapped here forever. It's already here. Don't let it find you.
3864580.name: P.O.N.

3891660.desc: The House Dreams Along With Them is a first person puzzle adventure with an emphasis on interactivity and logic. Sleep and dream in the rooms of a mysterious house. Solve the puzzles to make the dreams real and take a step towards the enigmatic reification of night.
3891660.name: The House Dreams Along With Them

3908970.desc: Mine every Shit Coin in the world.
3908970.name: Shit Coin Miner

3917850.desc: A realistic referee simulator! Show cards, use VAR, control matches, and rise through your referee career!
3917850.name: Football Referee Life Simulator 26

3932890.desc: Escape from Tarkov is the original extraction FPS where every raid is a gamble with death. Prep your raid, bleed, endure and fight through ruthless PMC players and Scavs, gain tactical advantage and cling to your loot — only extraction decides if you live or lose it all.
3932890.name: Escape from Tarkov

3936340.desc: HELL WAIT is riichi mahjong crossed with roguelike deckbuilding. Stack your jokers. Upgrade your yaku. Try not to deal in. You'll need those fingers.
3936340.name: Hell Wait

3940120.desc: Fight your way through unrelenting waves of enemies in this top-down roguelite deckbuilding bullet heaven. Build and upgrade your deck with powerful weapons and perks to survive the gauntlet, defeat the bosses, and escape!
3940120.name: Kevin's In Trouble

3941350.desc: Mine blocks across the screen, gather resources, and upgrade your tools. Build furnaces and automation systems to improve efficiency, then trigger chain reactions with special blocks to clear huge sections of the screen at once.
3941350.name: Mine It All!

394360.desc: Victory is at your fingertips! Your ability to lead your nation is your supreme weapon, the strategy game Hearts of Iron IV lets you take command of any nation in World War II; the most engaging conflict in world history.
394360.name: Hearts of Iron IV

3944590.desc: A heartfelt New Year’s story about relocation and growing up. From wrapping gifts to navigating bureaucracy, can you adjust to a new life and discover what home means to you now?
3944590.name: Relocat

3946460.desc: Design a beautiful cozy theme park or water park filled with rides, slides, decorations, and charm. Attract lovable Shroomies who wander around and bring your creation to life. A calm, cozy game about creativity and building your perfect little getaway.
3946460.name: Shroomy Garden

3946960.desc: Voody Hex is a roguelite plateformer. Enter into a voodoo cabaret and curse yourself to increase difficulty. You cannot attack - You need to survive.
3946960.name: Voody Hex

3962650.desc: Cozy puzzle and arcade games to play your way: in a little window that stays on top while you work, on Steam Deck, or on the couch with a controller. Untangle arrows, pour sand, sort hex stacks or squish jelly, one bite-sized round at a time.
3962650.name: Pixel Pegz

3967580.desc: Hexograph is a hexagonal twist on nonogram puzzles. Use logic to solve handcrafted multi-color grids, read clues across three directions, untangle special hint rules, and reveal colorful hidden pictures.
3967580.name: Hexograph

3973040.desc: Chop, upgrade, repeat. Venture into a fast-regrowing forest in this top-down incremental roguelite. Draft cards to expand your level-up deck, recruit woodcutter friends, and scale your logging empire to harvest massive amounts of timber.
3973040.name: Treeternal

3975350.desc: Stack & Sus is a physics-based social deduction party game where 3-6 players stack one giant burger. The Staff work together to complete the dish, while hidden Spies try to topple it without blowing their cover. Was that placement really an accident? Team up, stack up, and find the Spy!
3975350.name: Stack & Sus

3976630.desc: Astrobarian™ is a 3D action RPG game where you and Cordina travel to different worlds — some cultivated, others filled with deadly hazards. Along the way, you may encounter others with different motives and unresolved mysteries.
3976630.name: Astrobarian™

3978820.desc: A horror-infused extraction shooter for squads of three. Crush monster hordes with devastating firepower in co-op PvE, or take on rival squads for The Vertex in PvP. Choose your battle, push as far as you dare, and make it out alive.
3978820.name: Rules of Engagement: The Grey State

3981890.desc: Try to get as high as possible before one of the blocks falls out of the construction zone.
3981890.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Unstable Towers

3994800.desc: An unknown signal. A silent ship. Only traces of the crew and empty corridors remain on the Sentinel. As Elara Wynn, you investigate what happened—and why the last transmission was a desperate distress call from the depths of space...
3994800.name: White Whisper

3997770.desc: Battle Runes of Metalaria is an action packed, chaos infused board game for up to four players. Stack your runes on the board to make vertical and horizontal combos or smash your opponents pieces to smithereens
3997770.name: Battle Runes of Metalaria

40.desc: Enjoy fast-paced multiplayer gaming with Deathmatch Classic (a.k.a. DMC). Valve's tribute to the work of id software, DMC invites players to grab their rocket launchers and put their reflexes to the test in a collection of futuristic settings.
40.name: Deathmatch Classic

400.desc: Portal™ is a new single player game from Valve. Set in the mysterious Aperture Science Laboratories, Portal has been called one of the most innovative new games on the horizon and will offer gamers hours of unique gameplay.
400.name: Portal

4000.desc: Garry's Mod is a physics sandbox. There aren't any predefined aims or goals. We give you the tools and leave you to play.
4000.name: Garry's Mod

4001890.desc: A 1-4 player physics based fishing simulator. While drinking and boating you suddenly crash into a small island. To work your way back home you have to learn How to Fish.
4001890.name: How to Fish

4008250.desc: Risen Ballbylon is a transformative expansion for BALL x PIT, adding new levels, characters, balls, passives, enemies, bosses, and buildings, to the smash hit ball-bouncing roguelite. Will you rise to the challenge?
4008250.name: BALL x PIT: Risen Ballbylon

4009490.desc: Explore and survive in the Arctic, where your car is the only thing keeping you alive. Arctic Drive is a 1–4 player co-op survival sim set in a procedurally generated winter wilderness. Find supplies, repair your rig, and haul it all onwards with only one hope left: there must be safety out there.
4009490.name: Arctic Drive

4010820.desc: Eye of Darkness is a survivor game with a focus on exploration. You take on the role of a dark cultist on the path to awaken ancient evil - the Eye of Darkness. The forces of Light throw everything at you to stop you from plunging the world into eternal darkness.
4010820.name: Eye of Darkness

4018330.desc: Destroy the castle on the hill in this grim RPG where you play as the Dark Lord. Collect souls, summon an undead army, master dark abilities, craft powerful gear, build your base, and desecrate the lands of a vast open world.
4018330.name: Lord of Undead

4019220.desc: Become a dressmaker! Choose fabric, cut out pattern pieces and sew them all together to make the dresses of your dreams - in this cozy crafting game, inspired by real dressmaking.
4019220.name: Dressmaker

4031890.desc: Enjoy a farming life with mysterious creatures known as Pals! Team up with them to grow your farm at your own pace in this brand new creature-collecting farming sim, fully playable in multiplayer!
4031890.name: Palworld: Palfarm

4045480.desc: Draw your very own fish and build a cozy little aquarium. And if you like, set it as your animated desktop wallpaper! Watch your drawings come to life. Feed them, raise them and collect golden scales to unlock new decorations. There's also some handy tools to help you focus and unwind.
4045480.name: Drawquarium

4045760.desc: After losing your job, you return to your hometown to rebuild your life—and your family house. But you’re not alone. Two old friends, Lola and Mira, offer to help you renovate… and maybe build something more.
4045760.name: Project: Home!

4051290.desc: Tape Man is a puzzle platformer full of hidden mechanics. Throw your tape measure and set off into a vast maze built out of puzzles. The tape measure can serve as both a platform to stand on and a key to opening new paths — and it can do a lot more than that. You'll just have to find out.
4051290.name: Tape Man

4073100.desc: A horror game about the night shift at a donut shop. To help pay for your sister's treatment, you take seven nights behind the counter. Fry, glaze and box the orders, and serve the customer who comes in after closing and knows far too much about you.
4073100.name: Dreadnut

4077740.desc: PUBG: Black Budget is an extraction shooter built around tension, survival, and the unknown. Join a classified operation and uncover the secrets of a mysterious island trapped in a time loop.
4077740.name: PUBG: Black Budget

4080220.desc: Welcome to The World’s Game in EA SPORTS FC™ 27. Step into The Grounds to experience a football playground where the streets meet the stadium, and feel greater control in every mode as community-driven innovations deliver more true-to-football gameplay.
4080220.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 27

4082030.desc: Decorate the DreamHouse™ through the decades, while playing classic Barbie games. In Barbie™ Rewind, Barbie invites you into her cozy, creative world and entrusts you to customize her DreamHouse. Barbie also left you her game collection, so you can revisit your favorite Barbie video games.
4082030.name: Barbie™ Rewind

4088360.desc: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.
4088360.name: Funeral for the Sun

4095380.desc: From the creators of Warframe emerges a new Fantasy Action RPG. Forge your legend with blade, bow, and magick as you lead the charge against a world-devouring corruption.
4095380.name: Soulframe

4096910.desc: Organize. Optimize. Obliterate. Void Reaver is a sci-fi bullet heaven where your backpack is your firepower. Grid-manage 300+ weapons and artifacts into explosive synergies, unlock specialized skill trees, and blast through alien hordes to a high-octane electronic soundtrack.
4096910.name: Void Reaver

4099810.desc: 1999. The protagonist, a boy named Akira, finds himself lost in the TOKOYO Building—an indoor amusement park filled with secrets and eerie rumors. There, he begins living and working alongside its peculiar staff, but... did you know? People disappear in the TOKOYO Building.
4099810.name: 1999TOKOYO Building

4114080.desc: The political sandbox game where you build a career from state rep to the presidency. Authentic electoral systems, government departments, pass legislation, and a unique news landscape. Create custom scenarios, parties, and politicians in this data-driven democracy simulator.
4114080.name: StateOS: The Political Sandbox

4115450.desc: S-GAME presents Phantom Blade Zero, a fusion of classic Wuxia storytelling and exhilarating action powered by Unreal Engine 5. You play as Soul, a warrior with only sixty-six days left to live. Fend off assassins, unravel world-ending conspiracies, and defend your values with your life.
4115450.name: Phantom Blade Zero

4116260.desc: Hack into cameras, watch your hotwife, and use temptation as a tool to expose the truth behind a corporate heist. NTS/NTR unavoidable!
4116260.name: In-Security

4118000.desc: Thousands of aliens are coming. Expand your territory and build an army on a turn-based world map, then hold the line in real-time battle when a raid hits. Survive until the Final Assault on day 50.
4118000.name: Pest Termina ~ Swarm Defense

4119020.desc: Co-op Horror (4 players). Enemies mimic your teammates, environment lies to you. A brutal corporation promises you freedom, can your team survive the chaos?
4119020.name: Doomed Crew

4126040.desc: Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. Explore the vast continent of Idyll, Twine with unique Aniimo, unlock new abilities. Travel to a sky-floating metropolis, meet other Pathfinders, and battle in exciting competitions. Choose your Aniimo and begin your epic journey!
4126040.name: Aniimo

413150.desc: You've inherited your grandfather's old farm plot in Stardew Valley. Armed with hand-me-down tools and a few coins, you set out to begin your new life. Can you learn to live off the land and turn these overgrown fields into a thriving home?
413150.name: Stardew Valley

4140210.desc: A party-builder rogue like, build your party to survive the monsters guarding the crystal. Master the turn-based combat system and break your limits to see how far you can take your party.

4150720.desc: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.
4150720.name: Drunken Goddess Reflux

4162040.desc: Zenless Zone Zero is HoYoverse’s brand-new urban fantasy ARPG. Players act as "Proxies" who explore Hollows alongside a wide range of unique Agents, fighting enemies, and completing commissions on their journey to unveil the mysteries behind New Eridu.
4162040.name: Zenless Zone Zero

4165740.desc: An automation roguelike where a run fits in one session. Place hexagonal tiles to grow a production organism while the resource demands rise over time. Roll dice in the shop to buy more tiles, and pick perks that change the rules and try to completely break the economy.
4165740.name: Vena: Hex Automation Roguelike

4165870.desc: Your games at your fingertips All the inputs to play all the games on Steam, wherever Steam is
4165870.name: Steam Controller

4165890.desc: Your games in every dimension Wireless, comfortable, lightweight VR for your Steam library
4165890.name: Steam Frame

4165910.desc: Your games on the big screen Powerful PC gaming made easy, in a small and mighty package
4165910.name: Steam Machine

4171850.desc: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...
4171850.name: Trees Hate You

417910.desc: First, realistic PvP brawling game for up to 8 vs 8 players with original, dynamic combat system and fast, round based battles. Create and develop Your character. Earn new skills and items that helps You beat Your opponents. Gather Your friends and fight together in a clan.
417910.name: Street Warriors Online

4179990.desc: A farming and automation game where your automation is people. Hire workers, pay their salaries, build their houses, and lay out your farms and factories like a town. Produce and sell valuable goods to keep your business profitable. This isn't colony survival, it's running a company.
4179990.name: Agromatic

4184810.desc: An adrenaline-pumping bullet heaven where death is permanent. Hire and evolve unique companions, discover 950+ weapon variations, and fight through swarms of enemies and bosses. Grow stronger every run, but if your team falls, they're gone for good.
4184810.name: Bullet Meltdown

4185040.desc: A collection 48 lovingly hand crafted and hand-drawn micro games. Play with just a mouse and shoot for ALL the high scores! Try a random selection of games, or play each individually!
4185040.name: The Great 48

4185770.desc: cenker's mod is a multiplayer physics sandbox with many mods. Every mod has a different experience. Play included, community-made, and your own mods together with friends.
4185770.name: cenker's mod

4189160.desc: On Love, On Monsters is a Frankenstein-inspired story with an emphasis on love in its many forms. Play as three characters with alternating POVs; the Doctor, The Priest, and The Exile. Bond with allies and enemies, avoid raising suspicion in the town of Blackmoore, and learn what it means to love.
4189160.name: On Love, On Monsters

4191110.desc: Two vampires — an ambitious Kindred and a wretched Thinblood. Their fates clash in this Visual Novel set in the World of Darkness, where your arsenal extends beyond just words — from political machinations to forbidden Alchemy. Claw your way to power and leave your bitemarks on Berlin's underworld.
4191110.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Oaths & Ashes

4199910.desc: Experience the brutal fusion of galactic strategy and grimdark warfare in Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000. Take command of iconic factions, customise your war machine, and engage in devastating battles as you carve a bloody warpath across the stars.
4199910.name: Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000

4210250.desc: Logic Arrows is a sandbox game where you design your own mechanisms: from logic gates to an entire computer. Use simple elements to build complex systems, solve engineering challenges and master computer logic.
4210250.name: Logic Arrows

4215660.desc: After his fiancée returns to Japan for work in this visual novel by Dark One!, our protagonist begins dreaming of being a woman in the Middle Ages. The more he has these dreams, the more he becomes a woman in real life. Can he reverse his transformation, or will his life take a different turn?
4215660.name: TORAWASE: The Girl in the Mirror

4217650.desc: Command your dice to glorious victory in this strategic rogue-lite dicebuilder. Cast devastating spells, recruit powerful dice, and prove yourself worthy to challenge the great Commander Talis.
4217650.name: Tome of Talis: A Dice Conquest Game

4218360.desc: Build and lead a colony on the surface of an endless Wall. Manage resources and your people, develop new technologies, defend against relentless zyrex attacks, and send robo-spiders on risky expeditions. Keep the colony from collapsing – in Wall World, it's easy to fall.
4218360.name: Wall World Strategy

4228810.desc: Fourteen Years of Flames is a story-driven FPS that replays China’s struggle in the Second Sino-Japanese War (1931–1945). Players embody 7 key characters and battle through 16 real historical events, experiencing the hardships and sacrifices over 14 years of struggle. Land weeps in 14 years of war.
4228810.name: Fourteen Years of Flames

4249520.desc: Run an inn in the Otherworld, where forgotten things become tsukumogami. By day, tend to guests burdened by Kegare. By night, survive the horrors born from the impurity left behind. Your choices shape the guests’ healing and the inn’s fate.
4249520.name: 異界ノ宿帳

4250370.desc: Sol Protocol is a dynamic VR Co-Op roguelike where you team up and physically pilot a spaceship through dangerous, procedurally generated stellar systems. Manage your spaceship, man the turrets, explore abandoned stations on foot, and make strategic decisions as you push deeper into the deep space.
4250370.name: Sol Protocol

4253570.desc: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.
4253570.name: Reshine

4258290.desc: You and your friends are in trouble. Big trouble. You’ve accidentally killed someone, and now you have to get rid of the evidence. "We Are So Cooked" is a 1-4 player co-op physics-stealth game where the objective is simple: Get the body to the exit. The execution? That’s the hard part.
4258290.name: We Are So Cooked

4258790.desc: Solve over 150 tile based lawn puzzles. Explore the grounds of a forgotten manor. Discover mysterious flora and figure out their rules. Cut grass and have fun!
4258790.name: The Gardener

4258970.desc: Raise a procedural pet on your Windows desktop. Hatch eggs, feed and evolve pets, collect Crystals, unlock toys and scenes, and shape each body part to create a companion of your own. Switch between windowed and transparent desktop modes, enable click-through, or invite friends online.
4258970.name: Crawling Desktop Pet

4259360.desc: Rebuild a community one bottle at a time in this tiny delivery adventure with your pet cow Milki. Gather resources and upgrade your barn, then bike along dirt paths, breezy meadows, and seaside docks to bring fresh milk back to the sleepy countryside.
4259360.name: Milki Delivery

4260840.desc: A fifty-year, action-adventure saga of men with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. Use extreme violence to survive, and musical talent to thrive as a showman across five cities and eras of modern Japan.
4260840.name: STRANGER THAN HEAVEN

4262460.desc: ROB RUN is a brutal crime sandbox featuring thousands of players. Rise above everyone through the grit, the grime, and the struggle. Break free and take yourself from squalor by any means.
4262460.name: ROB RUN

4289450.desc: PegLotto! is a roguelike that combines slots, pachinko, and deck-building. Pick your items, place them on the board, and pray that luck is on your side! Sit back, enjoy the view from the train window, and ride the waves of fortune!
4289450.name: PegLotto!

4294670.desc: Move in with a family friend, the missing owner of Artimus Corp, a tech mega-conglomerate. As androids act strangely and your dreams unravel, uncover the truth of your past in this adult cyberpunk visual novel where choices shape relationships and a growing harem.
4294670.name: Aurora Protocol

4356430.desc: The hustle doesn’t stop and the run never ends in NBA 2K27. Chase greatness around the clock in MyCAREER, MyTEAM, and MyNBA, and make your hoop dreams a reality.

4369620.name: Last Harbor

4402200.name: Project Tomorrow

4408320.name: BATTLE BEARS GOLD

4423270.desc: Take to the streets solo or with a partner in this fast paced, high-impact arcade beat ’em up. Takeover returns with refined gameplay, upgraded visuals and a pulse-pounding new soundtrack.
4423270.name: Takeover 2

Drive hundreds of tanks, from museum classics to "did-that-ever-exist?" specials, in quick 5 to 7-minute brawls packed with metal mayhem. Play solo or team up with a friend and enjoy smooth action even on modest hardware!
444200.name: World of Tanks Blitz

4444310.desc: A shooter primarily focused on constantly aiming at various difficulties.
4444310.name: Rend

4452620.desc: Smash containers. Grab the gold. Find the hidden keys before time runs out. Recruit a crew of thieves and rob the lord again in this short medieval heist incremental.
4452620.name: Thieves and Gold

4492500.desc: The Cinder Throne is an Idler RPG where you passively kill enemies, level up, loot enemies, change pieces of equipment and find spells. Create powerfull synergies. Rebirth and come back stronger than ever
4492500.name: The Cinder Throne

4493130.desc: You're the Ski-E-O - build the cozy ski resort of your dreams in this management tycoon game. Adapt to ever-changing weather, paint trails, build lifts, and place the lodges and après bars that keep thousands of skiers warm, fed, and happy.
4493130.name: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon

4509300.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!

4521650.desc: Grow fresh ingredients and run your own little restaurant. Enjoy a peaceful day that stretches from the field to the table. Plan a fresh menu for a delightful day, keep your pantry full, and make your customers happy. Earn your own money and build your little world step by step.
4521650.name: Farm & Feast

4528040.desc: A grounded open-world survival crafting game where you're stranded alone on Mars. Explore the red planet, extract resources, build a pressurized base, manage oxygen, power, and food, and construct the rocket that's your only way home.

4529690.desc: You came to town to sell berries, but ended up managing a café with charming cow girls! Mix delicious cocktails, save the café from going under, and grow closer to your staff — and their attractive boss. Who knew a new job could change your life so much?

4559930.desc: Build and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, produce and sell resources, and grow your space through memories and a cozy atmosphere.
