4822240.name: Thronefall - Craaghelm

4822710.name: PICK A BOO Skin "Angel Halo & Wings"

4822740.desc: Build tiny empires with big ambitions. A cozy, bite-sized 4X where every turn counts: grow cities, research three historical ages, and outscore rivals through building, conquest, or exploration in short single player or multiplayer matches.
4822740.name: Tiny Conquests

4824610.desc: Resident Evil Veronica is a remake of 2000's Resident Evil Code: Veronica. In 2027, madness and intrigue, love and hate all combine to create a chilling new entry in survival horror.
4824610.name: Resident Evil Veronica

4825260.desc: Test your piloting skills in a 6-DOF space racer. Match up against others in the matchmaking mode, compete against AI, or race the clock solo. Clear as many rings as you can, and clear the finish line to lock in your time, top speed and accuracy. Get there first to win.
4825260.name: Great Space Race of 3032

4829700.desc: Massive expansion, Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance has been announced!
4829700.name: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance

4829780.desc: Frontier Tale is a cozy adventure farming game that blends extraction-style gameplay with town building. Forge weapons, explore a charming cel-shaded fantasy world, gather rare resources, recruit unique companions, and build your dream frontier from the ground up.
4829780.name: Frontier Tale

4832970.desc: What the Buck?! is a satisfying incremental game about destroying money. Shred stacks of cash, set off chain reactions across the table, prestige for permanent upgrades and automate your money destruction. Your demo progress carries over to the full game.
4832970.name: What the Buck?!

4837000.desc: Run off to the Japanese countryside to connect with your Grandfather. Breathe new life into your grandmother's garden, and get to know the locals of a rural Japanese town in this cozy life sim rpg.
4837000.name: Shin'ai Rewritten

4839040.desc: This is a light strategy simulation game that combines grid-based maps with search, attack, and retreat gameplay. You will play as a guardian of the rescue team, venturing into dangerous areas to find trapped female survivors.
4839040.name: X-Keepers

4841210.desc: Launch gladiators, earn money, and buy your freedom in a coliseum filled with chaos. Customize the voices of 7 types of gladiators using your microphone, unlock upgrades, overcome absurd events, and multiply your earnings with unpredictable physics.
4841210.name: Coliseum Slap

4842910.desc: A voxel-based virtual tabletop with full 3D building, movement, and fog-of-war. Place voxels in any color with a variety of 3D shape tools like rectangles, cylinders, ramps, pyramids, etc. Import any image as custom standees. Detailed GM control over player vision, teams, dice, and more!
4842910.name: Terrablox

4845020.desc: 为了筹集妹妹高昂的学费，守财奴男主新海幸意外踏入了名为「人才租赁」的奇妙行当。在扮演男友、密友乃至情夫的虚假契约掩护下，少女们不为人知的隐秘欲望与真实心声悄然绽放。以金钱维系的脆弱羁绊终将遭遇现实的考验，当这层层伪装剥落时，究竟会是财尽缘散，还是假戏真做呢？一场充满谎言与心跳的青春恋爱喜剧就此上演。
4845020.name: 恋爱，我就借走咯

4850520.desc: Press any key on your keyboard to drive Skoot toward that key’s position in the arena. Dodge, ram, and outmaneuver opponents in fast-paced vehicular brawls built around your entire keyboard. Take on boss fights, Endless Mode, and online PvP as you brawl throughout Skoot’s strange futuristic worlds.
4850520.name: Skoot: Keyboard Brawl

4857910.desc: Join the Kabebutt Show, a wild TV game show where you bring your girl best friend for a shot at ¥500,000! Five women’s butts are in front of you, and one belongs to your best friend. Play with each girl, examine them through four intense rounds, and make sure you don't pick your bestie early!
4857910.name: Kabebutt Royale

4858370.desc: Real-time image-enhancement tool for any game. No mods required.
4858370.name: Dr Pixel

4858460.desc: A medieval free-for-all for 2–8 friends. Lead your army as a hero, raise your Castle, launch yourself from your own Mangonel and talk your way into alliances with proximity voice — then betray them. Outlast your rivals or top the final standings.
4858460.name: PARLEY

4859770.desc: Enjoy ColorByNumber in 3D voxel art. Match the numbers, paint the blocks, and create beautiful 3D artwork in this relaxing experience. Complete a variety of models, from cute animals to massive buildings, and unleash your creativity in Sandbox Mode!
4859770.name: CrystalCanvas

4861910.desc: Pin-Finite is a Roguelike deck-builder pinball game. Purchase unique and powerful upgrades to blow the lid on your points! Unlock rare pinballs and combos to scale your runs to infinity!
4861910.name: Pin-Finite

4863180.desc: Fast-Paced Tower Defense Game Where Space Is Used To Manipulate Enemy Behavior | Towers And Upgrades Take Up Space On The Board | Make The Enemy Decide Whether They Should Attack The Tower, Or Go Around!
4863180.name: Defend The HexCore

4873800.desc: Solve rotating puzzles with cute cat girls. Cozy, soft-incremental gameplay. Chat With Cat Girls. Somehow Get Better at Puzzles. Make Questionable Choices. Unlock Surprisingly Useful Stuff.
4873800.name: Mosaique Neko Waifus 6

4876650.desc: Somewhere under that mountain of bricks is your floor. Sort the impossible Pile with a magnet glove, sieves, and part-seeking vision. Fill labeled drawers, pull parts, watch MOC builds snap together brick by brick. Cozy, satisfying, and governed by one rule: never sort by color.
4876650.name: Never Sort By Color

4878180.desc: The Crazy Eights roguelike. Every 8 is wild: call the suit, keep the chain alive, and cash out monster combos. Build decks that bend the rules, stack House Rules that multiply each other, and break the casino one floor at a time.
4878180.name: Wild Crazy 8s

4878710.desc: 你将扮演一个被AI淘汰的程序员，回到那个停滞的小县城，与那个等了你十二年的女孩一起去寻找，从所有人记忆里消失的发小和尘封的往事，你们追查的不仅仅是真相，还是被AI一起困住的那个夏天、那座小城、那段永远不会结束的等待。
4878710.name: 知夏

4879470.desc: Search a persistent hay pile with millions of candidates and one winning needle. Work strand by strand alone or with up to three friends, sort the mess, sell strange finds, and unlock better tools in a cozy first-person test of patience.
4879470.name: A Needle In a Haystack

4880820.desc: 《疾风群侠传》是一款武侠题材的多周目养成Roguelike游戏。在不断推进的江湖岁月中，自由修炼武学，加入风栖谷或凌霄门，踏上截然不同的门派道路。邂逅多位性格各异的红颜，在随机见闻、奇遇抉择与生死战斗中积累实力，探寻身世之谜，决定正邪立场，谱写独属于你的侠客传奇。
4880820.name: 疾风群侠传

4886710.desc: One mouse, One mushroom, No chackpoints.
4886710.name: Mushroom Must Go Up!

4887480.desc: A deep pro-football front-office sim. Draft through a fog of scouting, build contracts that come due years later, develop raw kids into stars, and outlast 31 rival GMs who scout, bluff, and hold grudges. No play-calling. Every decision is yours, and so is every consequence.
4887480.name: Gridiron Grit

4898190.desc: Erevael is a fantasy RPG on a hex map that's different every game. There are no classes. You get better at whatever you do, from trading and mapmaking to magic and fighting. When your character retires, you carry on as their heir with their spells, recipes and maps.
4898190.name: Erevael

489830.desc: Winner of more than 200 Game of the Year Awards, The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition brings the epic fantasy to life in stunning detail. The Special Edition includes the critically acclaimed game and add-ons with all-new features.
489830.name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition

4900110.desc: Well, nice catch! You caught a mermaid with a tempting smile and she isn’t going to let you go that easily. Reel her closer, uncover the secrets of the deep and chase six endings: from sweet romance to something much darker.
4900110.name: Oops… I Hooked Up with a Mermaid 🎣😳

4901540.desc: Pick up a brick and build a little world. Follow the instructions, add stickers, and collect new models in this cozy brick-building game. Unwind on your own or grow your collection with friends.
4901540.name: Brick Buddies

4901860.desc: An arcade incremental where you ARE the tornado. Suck up cows, flatten cities, and spend the cash on upgrades between runs. Become fire, flood, winter or void. Start with a blade of grass. Tear Earth apart, then take your storm to an alien world. Raise cows on a farm of your own.
4901860.name: The Big Suck

4904730.desc: Click flies, unlock achievements, and complete your collection. A simple and satisfying clicker designed for achievement hunters.
4904730.name: Achievement Fly Clicker

4907430.desc: A thrilling Co-op Action Roguelite for 1-4 players! Play as mischievous ghosts, create insane weapon synergies, catch humans, and turn them into pumpkins. Deliver your harvest to the crypt, expand the map, and unleash vibrant chaos in this Bullet Heaven!
4907430.name: GrindFall

4908110.desc: Run a chaotic gas station sandbox: fuel cars, clean and repair vehicles, buy wild tools, catch wanted drivers, earn reviews, unlock upgrades, climb the leaderboard, or turn every stop into total mayhem.
4908110.name: Gas N Cars

4912740.desc: Bake, decorate, and serve beautiful cakes for customers celebrating life's special moments. Customize every order, expand your bakery with new ingredients and decorations, and create the coziest cake shop in town at your own relaxing pace.
4912740.name: Cake & Bake

4915700.desc: Ebbtide is a zombie survival strategy game. Lead the last carrier task force through a world overrun by the dead, starting in Los Angeles: direct your forces on a real-time operations map, then zoom straight into the 3D pixel-art battlefield to command the fight or take direct control.
4915700.name: Ebbtide

4920280.desc: Hang a battlefield on your desktop and let your soldier fight and grow automatically. Plan talents, buy gear, refine builds, and use APM to boost combat speed. Team up with friends for ranked battles, chase higher KDA and scores, and find out who is best at “strategic slacking” during work.
4920280.name: 喵呜风云

4921660.desc: Rank 5 words from S to D to fit the prompt, then everyone guesses the star's ranking in this online party game for 2–10 players. Perfect matches get cheers, wild misses get laughs!
4921660.name: EVERYONE'S TIER LIST!

4928450.desc: 1-4+ players time-travel kidnapping-collection dungeon-crawling heist with physics, guns, bosses, arena, homebase, skins, and stocks! Kidnap people across 200+ worlds of history & fiction, haul them home in cages and farm paradox in your garage. 25+ theme packs, 2,000+ NPCs and Workshop mods!
4928450.name: Grand Theft Timeline

4934400.desc: GameLaunchSimulator is a text-based management sim about the full journey of publishing an indie game. Build your studio, plan new projects, prepare store pages, grow wishlists, handle reviews, release windows, publishing deals, and post-launch operations, then bring an unknown game to real players.
4934400.name: 游戏发行模拟器 Game Launch Simulator

4935280.desc: vim racer is a speed based training game that teaches real Vim motions by racing a block cursor through real source code, from h j k l all the way to search and bracket matching. There's no accuracy score, only speed, so the fastest path is always the correct one.
4935280.name: vim racer

4940980.desc: Run a cozy ramen bar in a busy Japanese city. Prepare bowls, serve customers, and keep the place clean, all while expanding your menu every day. But when you're alone something doesn't feel quite right...
4940980.name: The Ramen Bar

4942010.desc: A game console you can walk into. Astrolobe OS is an orbital station with a desk of your own, original games including TERMINAL ORION, and a real desktop for work. Full controller support for most controllers out of the box in every game, plus 4-player split screen on games that support it.
4942010.name: Astrolobe OS

4943870.desc: To solidify the new Demon King's authority, violate the incoming heroes and broadcast their shameful, lust-broken submission for the entire world to see!
4943870.name: The Demon King's Reclusive Strategist

4946550.desc: A short, satisfying incremental game about breaking blocks. Destroy blocks, unlock new tools and upgrades, and break even more blocks.
4946550.name: Deblock

4947250.desc: Build and run your own kebab restaurant in a single-player management simulation. Set prices, hire staff, serve customers, keep the shop clean, upgrade the interior, and turn a small counter into a thriving food business.
4947250.name: Kebab Dynasty

4948940.desc: Swarmbreaker is an incremental tower defense game where you must defend your base from a giant living wave of alien bugs. Build defenses to block their path, deploy heavy weapons, upgrade your arsenal, and break the swarm!
4948940.name: Swarmbreaker

4949400.desc: MY CAT SCATTERED GAMES is a tidy up organizing game. Put 5,158 games and consoles back on the shelves, restore your video game store, and free your mischievous cat from the claw machine. Play by yourself or with up to 3 friends in co-op!
4949400.name: MY CAT SCATTERED GAMES: Tidy Videogame Supermarket

4951630.desc: Ride your own music. Soundway transforms any song into a neon roller coaster racing through deep space, with every burst of speed, climb, drop, and turn shaped by the track itself. Catch the beat, build massive combos, dodge hazards, and chase the music across the stars.
4951630.name: Soundway

49520.desc: The Ultimate Vault Hunter’s Upgrade lets you get the most out of the Borderlands 2 experience.
49520.name: Borderlands 2

4954910.desc: Run a scam call center with your friends. Use increasingly ridiculous schemes to trick AI callers out of their life savings. Hit your daily quota, cause chaos around the office, and survive a brutal performance review from your rageaholic boss.
4954910.name: Scam With Your Friends

4954970.desc: One of you is the cop. The rest are panicked suspects. Hide the body, clean up the evidence, don’t rat each other out, and get rid of everything before your cop friend knocks on the door. There is only one rule: if the body is found, you’re all done for.
4954970.name: No Body No Problem!

4955600.desc: A vertical-climbing action roguelike: scale a massive tower as a capybara while your weapons fire on their own, bullet-heaven style. Level up, shape your build, take on quests, and unlock weapons and characters. Every run generates a brand-new tower.
4955600.name: Capy of Gods

4956460.desc: A happy North American neighborhood awaits you! Play solo or with up to 9 friends. Build your crew, take on jobs around the neighborhood, earn money and buy houses. Create your own cash flow and happily build your real estate empire!
4956460.name: AMERICAN LIFE SIMULATOR

4960640.desc: KIT Three Kingdoms: Heroes at War is a logistics-driven strategy game. Govern cities, recruit officers and move armies across a grand map, then command formations, Battle Arts, Stratagems, sieges and duels in real time. Choose a faction in seven sandbox starts and unite the realm.
4960640.name: KIT Three Kingdoms: Heroes at War

4961250.desc: You are the prince of a small kingdom. Defend its castles from monsters in this tower defense game!
4961250.name: The Rookie Prince's Defense Trials

4970630.desc: Fill a giant 5,000,000-liter jar in the valley! Harvest your first honeycomb by hand, lay hose networks, and scale up to 10,000 liters/sec with drones and full automation. Unlock 200+ upgrades, play guitar on your farm, and uncover the jar's secret in this cozy 8-10 hour journey!
4970630.name: Beellionaire Incremental: Bee Simulator

4971410.desc: A multiplayer bullet hell where everyone is a tank.
4971410.name: Tankii

4972690.desc: You’re Blue Guy—elite SWAT, last clean suit left. Kite toxic bugs while your loadout auto-fires, then fight from the Forest through the Desert to the leaking Factory. Five skulls a zone. Wipe the hive.
4972690.name: Blue Guy Must Die

4975340.desc: Zero-gravity pool, seen through a porthole in the cue ball, because that's where you are. Fifteen numbered balls float in a sealed room with a pocket in every corner. Every shot throws you backward: it's how you get around, and how you sink yourself. Solo, vs a bot, or with a friend on one screen.
4975340.name: 3D Bumper Billiards

4976270.desc: Someone Seems to Be in “My” Room! The renowned writer Koi wakes up in the middle of the night, but finds himself unable to fall back asleep…
4976270.name: A Warm Story

4977170.desc: A unique robot fighting action game built around simple controls, precise timing, and martial arts-inspired combat.
4977170.name: ROBOTEKA

4978080.desc: Chain cards by matching suits or ranks, then use strategic sequencing and item combos to rack up explosive scores. Turn your debt-ridden life around at Maou-chan’s casino in this single-player card game.
4978080.name: CARTA CHAIN: Maou-chan’s Deal

4982580.desc: Top-down arcade football for the whole crew. Up to 6 players on one couch, or online with friends over Steam. Tournaments, football-tennis, penalties, minigames and legendary moments to fire up the match. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down. Grab a controller and score!
4982580.name: 3 Estrellas

4983040.desc: A Minesweeper incremental game where you mine resources, upgrade your pickaxe and stats, and avoid being killed by enemies on your way to revealing ancient relics.
4983040.name: Would you mine?

4984400.desc: Word Game Tower Defense. Spell AXE to harvest wood. Spell FORT to make an armored tower. Every word you spell becomes a tower with unique stats and powers. Every word is also a unique level with procedural challenges. 121,683 levels. Together we must clear them all to reach paradise.
4984400.name: Towers of Babble

4986330.desc: Your hands are the controller. Wave at your webcam, pinch to grab blocks, and stack a tower tall enough to carry the key to the lock. Solve physics puzzles across 90+ levels of wood, stone, glass, rope, and hope. Webcam required.
4986330.name: Handsy

4987490.desc: Run a cozy bakery for cats! Experiment with ingredients, discover new recipes, serve your feline customers, and uncover six interconnected stories, each told from the perspective of a different cat.
4987490.name: Cats Love Cakes

4988280.desc: There is a pretty big pile of colored cubes. Sort those cubes by color into trucks. That is pretty much all there is! This game came to me in a dream, so I made it. Treat it as something to chip away at over time, slowly uncovering whatever lies within the pile.
4988280.name: The Pretty Big Pile

4988440.desc: GUGUGAGA! Sudoku! Minesweeper! Combined gameplay!! Plus, you can play online with friends!!!
4988440.name: GUGUGAGA: PEEKABOO

4990840.desc: Model, paint, and blend in! FAKE ME is an online multiplayer hide-and-seek game where you create your own disguise. Use simple 3D modeling tools to build the object you’ll hide as. You can also create your own costume by modeling. Hide from the Seekers or find every Faker before time runs out!
4990840.name: FAKE ME

4992660.desc: Kenguin Sting, a failed horror writer, buys a cheap asset-store house to write his masterpiece. His only job: feed the cats. And keep Grandma on her pills. And survive 4 days and 4 nights. An absurd parody horror game.
4992660.name: Scawy Game

4993270.desc: Command frontlines directly in a real time territorial strategy game. Push borders, link settlements with supply roads, and break defenses with cavalry and naval landings. Includes six historical campaigns, Skirmish, a built in map editor, and online matches for up to eight players.
4993270.name: Palisade

4993730.desc: A PSX-style horror game set in an abandoned household. Do the chores, uncover what happened here, and survive whatever's sharing the house .
4993730.name: Arachnid

4994750.desc: Build an outrageous deck of alien cards and deploy them onto the battle field. Unleash game-breaking combos in this tactical roguelite deckbuilder.
4994750.name: Nick vs the Brick of Ick from space

4999850.desc: The curated soundtrack to First Light: 33 tracks across Quiet Mornings, Easy Evenings and Arcade Nights. An hour and a half of music, from kitchens at sunrise to night drives and arcade glow, each track with its own cover art. The one vocal track, There You Are, opens the album and ends the game.
4999850.name: First Light Soundtrack

50.desc: Return to the Black Mesa Research Facility as one of the military specialists assigned to eliminate Gordon Freeman. Experience an entirely new episode of single player action. Meet fierce alien opponents, and experiment with new weaponry. Named 'Game of the Year' by the Academy of Interactive Arts and Sciences.
50.name: Half-Life: Opposing Force

500.desc: From Valve (the creators of Counter-Strike, Half-Life and more) comes Left 4 Dead, a co-op action horror game for the PC and Xbox 360 that casts up to four players in an epic struggle for survival against swarming zombie hordes and terrifying mutant monsters.
500.name: Left 4 Dead

5001770.desc: Build and grow your own farm and roadside market. Grow crops, raise animals, craft valuable products, set prices, hire employees, stock your shelves, serve customers, and expand your small operation into a thriving business.
5001770.name: Farmstead Market Simulator

5005580.desc: A neon bullet heaven at absurd scale. Thousands of wireframe enemies, one auto-firing interceptor, and a grid floor that buckles beneath the swarm. Draft augments, evolve your weapons, and survive a boss every five waves — until the Black Hole arrives at wave thirty, then it's the Finale wave!
5005580.name: Nova Protocol

5005700.desc: Muv-Luv Girls Garden Mellow Days is a productivity companion ADV where you work alongside Meru Momozono. Customize your Pomodoro timer, ToDo list, calendar, music, and ambient sounds. As you spend more time together, your story with Meru gradually unfolds.
5005700.name: MUV-LUV GIRLS GARDEN Mellow Days

5006530.desc: Geralt of Rivia returns to the Path in The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Songs of the Past — a brand new expansion to one of the best-selling role-playing games of all time. Explore an entirely new region, quests, and characters in an authentic Witcher story of choices and consequences.
5006530.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Songs of the Past

5016250.desc: A dice game scored on Yahtzee hands. Roll, hold what's worth keeping, roll the rest again. Clear the target score and you move down a stage, and a shop opens in between. On the way down you hit stages where the dealer has bent one rule.
5016250.name: Lucky Hell

5019800.desc: Top-down co-op survival action RPG for 1–4 players in a world the System turned into a game. Earn levels, quests and psychic powers, scavenge the ruins, fight zombies and build an underground bunker for survivors — then find out what the System really wants.
5019800.name: System Arrival

5021660.desc: 21 windows. One real sniper. Two decoys. Scan the building, identify the threat, and take your shot without harming civilians. Test your observation, accuracy, and decision-making against the computer or challenge another player in asynchronous tactical sniper duels.
5021660.name: Scope Sweeper

5029580.desc: Work With Script is screenplay-centered production software for film, video games, and theatre. Write, plan, collaborate, compose, budget, and organize your entire production around the story — all in one focused creative workspace.
5029580.name: Work With Script

5032670.desc: The Fantastic Four's most powerful member and their greatest adversary are here! Play as The Invisible Woman and Doctor Doom or face the perils of Castle Doomstadt in a brand new game mode, now in our second DLC for MARVEL Cosmic Invasion!
5032670.name: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion - The Siege of Castle Doom

5033060.desc: Menthal is a first-person horror game where you are the test subject. Take experimental medicine, endure the side effects, and try to survive what happens next.
5033060.name: Menthal

5036510.desc: Kreabordis is a puzzle game where you have to strategically place creatures on a board to score the most points. Defeat challengers, maximize your points in tricky puzzles and find the perfect move.
5036510.name: Kreabordis

5037200.desc: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with unique yet intuitive controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!
5037200.name: just volleyball

5039030.desc: The world has gone dark! and only your hamsters can fix it. Spin the wheel, collect strange little hamsters and upgrade until your room powers the city, the country and the whole planet. A cozy incremental clicker that keeps running while you're away.
5039030.name: Wheel Be Fine

5040220.desc: HoloCozy is a cozy idle desktop companion where you can spend relaxing time with hololive talents in their rooms. Enjoy music and ambient sounds, keep your favorite characters close, and watch them grow at your own pace while you work, study, or unwind.
5040220.name: HoloCozy

5051090.desc: Take a well-deserved break before searching for your next job! Spend time doing all the things you've always wanted to: cook delicious meals, relax, collect cute figurines, chat with friends, and enjoy life at your own pace. Work can wait a little longer... you've earned this vacation.
5051090.name: The Cozy Funemployment

5053940.desc: Build the theme park of your dreams. Lay the roads, place the rides, open the shops and keep every guest smiling from the gate to the last bus home. A bright, cozy park builder with a ten-location campaign, free play with no limits, and a front-seat view of every ride you put down.
5053940.name: Amusement Factory

5056320.desc: Fantorob is a futuristic take on classic monster-taming genre. Build robots and fight against your opponents to collect components and upgrade your team in this thrilling turn-based combat RPG with brain-twisting puzzles. Join the journey to become the greatest robot master!
5056320.name: Fantorob

5057050.desc: Rulebound is a surreal horror incremental game where survival depends on split attention. Trapped in the Void, play a strange disc-merging game on an old CRT TV. Bounce and merge discs, buy upgrades, and forge 3 Golden Discs while watching for entities in the dark.
5057050.name: Rulebound

5058180.desc: 《BLINDFOLD: Sound Chase》 is an asymmetric online tag game where one blindfolded seeker faces off against several runners. An invisible seeker and runners who are in danger if they make a sound. A simple game of tag turns into a tense psychological battle.
5058180.name: BLINDFOLD: Sound Chase

5061060.desc: Plum is a 3d cozy platforming and collectathon game where you will have to roll and bounce through the valley in search for home. On your way, meet different ghost plums each which a story to share. This game is a colorful stylized short adventure (about 1h) made to chill or speedrunning.
5061060.name: Plum

5061890.desc: The definitive pirate-themed roguelite word game. Use letters from your grid to make words that move you along the treasure map, then obtain tools and powerful charms to keep the expedition going. With a pool of over 300 effects to discover, every run is unique and sometimes there's a coconut.
5061890.name: Scramshaw

5064170.desc: Your weapons fire on their own. Your job is to keep moving. Wall-run, dash and bunny-hop through hordes of monsters across 11 worlds, and turn 71 weapons and 131 items into an unstoppable build. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.
5064170.name: Go Next!

5065500.desc: Do the math and survive the aftermath. An easy-to-learn card battler: pull off math combos, get stuck in a fraction, stack functions until the numbers go absurd, break the enemy lines, try not to divide by zero. Real, modern, correct math. But when math isn't enough, resort to more arcane means...
5065500.name: Vinculum

5066010.desc: Here Comes the Horde is an incremental auto-battler where your vast armies defend your castle against hordes of undead enemies. Survive the attacks, unlock new units, obtain powerful abilities, and fill the screen with thousands of troops.
5066010.name: Here Comes the Horde

5068940.desc: A mesmerizing cooperative exploration for two to eight people, or a sandbox for one. Explore the colors and motion dynamics, save presets of your favorites to enjoy later and swap with others, and share a canvas with a friend, or a stranger, and make something neither of you could have made alone.
5068940.name: Swirl Together

5069180.desc: Hakurei Reimu comes to your desktop. Poke her or pick her up and she reacts just like Reimu would, and she'll keep an eye on your to-dos and alarms too. Blunt, but the type who quietly sticks by your side.
5069180.name: Touhou: Your Reimu

5072600.desc: Build a family of thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!
5072600.name: Family Time

5173530.desc: Dive into the heart of the southern french region of Provence, in a tiny hamlet where the only people left are seniors gradually growing apart. Shake up their routine to bring them back together at the local café, in a short experience where you're never too old to look towards the future.

5311120.name: Treasure Hunt Dungeon

5371810.desc: Cozy Tent is a quiet, single-player ambience game. Stay inside a tent in the forest while the rain falls: make a hot drink, read, play chess, watch a sky that follows the real clock and moon, and share the tent with a ferret.
5371810.name: Cozy Tent

5373210.desc: Build roads, intersections, and tram lines. The city grows on its own along the roads you lay. Ease congestion and turn a village into a metropolis.
5373210.name: Arteria

5373260.desc: Sound in liquid form. Ferro is a real-time 3D audio-reactive fluid simulation. Shape liquid, light and motion with music, MIDI, automation, or even your microphone. Infinitely customizable, place on your desktop or add to your livestream for an expressive companion to your sound.
5373260.name: Ferro - 3D Audio Visualizer

5375770.desc: Become the last Reaper in a brutal dark fantasy action game featuring precision sword combat, reactive enemy AI, advanced gore physics, and devastating supernatural abilities. Master deadly encounters, command, and unleash carnage across endless waves of enemies.
5375770.name: Mox Nox

5375890.desc: Turn a chaotic dice shop into a satisfying collection. Pick up, inspect and sort 4,095 colorful dice into matching sets, fill wooden shelves and unlock handy upgrades in this cozy first-person organizing game.
5375890.name: Sort Them Dice

5378110.desc: Mow lawns in first person on a beat-up riding mower, solo or online co-op up to 6 players. You're a grumpy old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care, but leaves perfect stripes. A picky neighbor, an abandoned golf course, an island wedding.
5378110.name: One More Lawn

5378180.desc: Free 4K pack for Dawn. It adds the whole film in 2160p and 10-bit colour, with the film grain intact. The download is optional, about 20 GB, and you pick it in the player's settings. You need the film to use it.
5378180.name: DAWN AEROWAR - Pack 4K

5379520.desc: A knockout party game for 1–8 friends online. 69 minigames of reflexes, memory, aim and nerve, each explained in one line. Everyone plays the same level at the same time. Fail, or come last, and you're out. First to 100 points is the smartest in the room.
5379520.name: Smartest in the Room

5379640.desc: Aim for the head as zombies close in through darkness and fear. Earn gold, unlock permanent upgrades, and survive escalating waves of special infected and bosses in this 2D pixel survival shooter. Choose upgrades carefully, control the horde, and push for a higher score in every short run.
5379640.name: HEADSHOT: Zombie Doomsday

5380110.desc: Peekour is a 2D pixel art platformer. YOU desperately need to pee and only the final toilet counts! Run, jump and parkour through 6+ levels. Collect coins and bottles of water to get more pee, and customize your experience with 40+ skins.
5380110.name: Peekour

5380650.desc: Retro arcade action meets glowing 3D voxels in this twin-stick arena shooter. Dodge bullets, shatter enemy ships and turn wreckage into upgrades. Build your ship across five sectors, then push further in Overdrive and Endless mode.
5380650.name: VOXFRAG

5381260.desc: Terrum DeepDrill is a single-player drilling game in a 2.5D side view. Terrum Corp owns your debt and calls it a contract. Win tenders against rival firms, drill through the rock, and haul enough ore to stay ahead of the bill.
5381260.name: Terrum DeepDrill

5386810.desc: Your first night shift in a police evidence archive nobody has filed in years. Pick up loose papers, photos and tapes, uncover hidden case numbers with the right tool, then press, stamp, box and shelve each case. No clock, no quota, no way to fail.
5386810.name: Evidence Vault

5389200.desc: An online space-mining idle incremental game that lives in the corner of your screen. Mine alongside other pilots, unlock automatic mining, upgrade your ship, and build your own orbital station while you work or browse.
5389200.name: Asteroid Watch

5389650.desc: EVO RNG is slot-machine god-game - draft creatures, press spin and watch your ecosystem hunt, merge and evolve on its own. Collect, chase paylines, food chains and mythic creatures. Game does not contain any real money gambling elements.
5389650.name: EVO RNG

5391510.desc: Learn game theory optimal (GTO) poker five minutes a day. Tea Break deals you a hand, a seat and a decision, grades your answer against solver output, and tells you which idea a mistake broke. A study tool for No Limit cash Hold'em, not a poker game: no real money, no wagering.
5391510.name: Tea Break Poker Trainer

5396440.desc: Poke, stretch and fling your squishy jelly! Every texture feels different. Then trap rivals with jelly bombs — pang-pang! Stages 1–15 are free; the Full Version Unlock DLC adds 16–50.
5396440.name: Pop! Jelly PangPang

5398160.desc: Gopher It is a cozy first-person job sim about being the newest intern in an office full of animals. When someone calls, you go and do what they want: copies, coffee, the post, a birthday card to pass round. Play solo or with up to three friends. No timers, no game over.
5398160.name: Gopher It: Office Intern Simulator

5399970.desc: Air Support is a top-down arcade helicopter shooter in a world of plastic toy soldiers. Fly a Green Army gunship over backyard battlefields, blast the Tan Army, winch up cargo, and bring a friend in co-op.
5399970.name: Plastic Soldiers: Air Support

5403380.desc: Your little brother mashed your toy bricks into ugly lumps and left them on your desk. Pull them apart, sort every piece into the bin with its picture, then follow a booklet whose steps play like little videos and build something lovely. Just one more piece...
5403380.name: One More Piece

5403800.desc: A cozy gold panning game. Wash the creek gravel, watch the gold settle in your pan, sell your finds in the village, and turn a small empty room into a home. No timers, no failure. Just quiet, golden little days.
5403800.name: Golden Pan

5404190.desc: A touch-based puzzle simulation game. A woman has been strapped to a new type of bomb, and her heart rate is linked to its trigger. Remove the restraints and tasks across her body, make her climax, and defuse the bomb. Features animated scenes and 2 endings.
5404190.name: Bomb Disposal

5404460.desc: A cozy first-person tidying game. Thousands of board game boxes lie scattered across a charming two-storey shop. Gather stacks of copies, shelve every game in its category and watch the shop come back to life, one satisfying section at a time.
5404460.name: The Cozy Board Game Shop: Tidy Up

5405270.desc: Słownikowa Wyspa is a Polish-language educational adventure game. Join Mizuki on a journey across a mysterious island, solve word puzzles, explore unique locations, collect missing book pages, and discover fascinating facts in an illustrated encyclopedia.
5405270.name: Słownikowa Wyspa

5405460.desc: A digital comic set in the Beholder universe, presented as a handbook for the ever-watchful landlord. Discover the fine art of minding everyone else's business through dark humor, suspicious tenants, and the absurd rules of the Great State that never stops watching.
5405460.name: Beholder: The Landlord's Handbook - Digital Comic

5405820.desc: A red-hooded archer, a silver moon bow and a horde that never runs out. Moonbow Idle is a dark fantasy auto battler: leave it on a second monitor or sit down and min-max. Hatch pets, farm boss gear, ascend, go deeper.
5405820.name: Moonbow Idle: Dark Fantasy Auto Battler

5411310.desc: Smash crates as Tin, a tiny salvage robot with a hammer, and free the memories locked inside ten vaults. A handful of crates grows into total havoc of lightning, saw blades and drones in this 5–7 hour incremental game with a real ending.
5411310.name: Tiny Havoc

5418900.desc: The echoes of a forgotten kingdom await. This is the official Thronefall soundtrack, with music from the base game and the Craaghelm DLC. Strings by day, drums by night. To hear, you only have to listen.
5418900.name: Thronefall Soundtrack

5420690.desc: This is an online RPG featuring a retro fantasy aesthetic. Starting from Talking Island, you can play as a Knight or a Wizard, exploring villages, wilderness areas, and underground dungeons. Engage in real-time combat to hunt monsters and gather loot as you gradually develop your character.
5420690.name: 天堂世族網路遊戲 (Royal Lineage Online)

5421150.desc: BIG CLIMB is a co-op climbing game for 1-4 players tied by a real physical rope. Climb the mountain together before the colossal spider gets the one lagging behind.
5421150.name: Big Climb

5423880.desc: You’re trapped in a room with a thousand fingers. Press them, gather supplies and try to survive the consequences. Experiment and find a way out solo or with friends—up to four players. In PvP, grab a weapon and fight free-for-all or two against two.
5423880.name: Don't Press This SH*T

5424890.desc: This is a video game based on the Backrooms myth, but it breaks away from its lore to tell an original story. It features a variety of gameplay sections with different creatures and a narrative-driven approach that sets it apart from other games based on these locations.
5424890.name: Backrooms: 1977

5425210.desc: Explore the maze. Collect the gems. Uncover its secrets. Dungeon Escape 3 is a 2D top-down maze escape game featuring over 30 levels to explore, hidden collectibles to discover, and puzzles to solve. Navigate through a maze of interconnected rooms, unlock new paths, and see how far you can go.
5425210.name: Dungeon Escape 3

5427130.desc: Upwardly is a colorful 3D precision platformer. Climb 10 castles across 5,000 meters, dodge deadly hazards, and race the clock. Choose from three difficulty modes, master every jump, and chase your personal best on randomized or shareable seeded courses.
5427130.name: Upwardly

5431930.desc: In 1980, Dad left a small vintage shop and 300 yuan. You took the counter and rang the bell. Ice lollies, enamel mugs, frog sunglasses, Yanwu tape recorders filled the shelves. Seventy antiques, ten regular neighbours, a new paper each day. Running the shop means holding onto life.
5431930.name: 旧物小铺

5433870.desc: Survive a night of Chinese folklore in Ghosts Before Dawn, a pixel-art survivor-like. Wield auto-casting talismans, flying swords, and spirit-banishing gongs. Combine weapons and the Five Elements, brave haunted villages and ghost markets, then face the final bosses after ten minutes of survival.
5433870.name: Ghosts Before Dawn

5435190.desc: A five-in-a-row board game with an engine that explains itself: every move comes with the shape it built, the threat it answered and the alternatives it weighed. Learn from ten lessons and 1,680 proven puzzles, review your games move by move, and play ranked online or entirely offline.
5435190.name: GomokuZero

5437060.desc: Your tabletop RPG, together on LAN or online. Join and play free with characters, dice, animated movement and session messages. Full Toolkit DLC unlocks campaign creation, grid and gridless maps, content editors and GM hosting. Optional accounts connect your community.
5437060.name: Game Master

5437570.desc: Create your character, pick your starting gear, and settle into a rented cabin in this immersive, relaxing life simulator. Forage, work odd jobs, sell junk at the thrift store, and keep yourself fed and clean as you save up for the cabin of your dreams.
5437570.name: Cabin Life

5437650.desc: The classic online strategy game of empires and ancient artifacts, reborn. Found cities, raise armies of thousands and race rival players across a living world to seize the legendary Artifacts. Free to play, with one account on PC, browser and phone.
5437650.name: Artifact Reforged

5438460.desc: Cyberpunk pixel-art auto-shooter. Your weapons fire on their own: you dodge bullet curtains, freeze the battlefield with Stasis, and pick 1 of 3 new weapons every floor. Climb 50 floors across 5 worlds and take down 10 bosses.
5438460.name: STASIS PROTOCOL

5438730.desc: Fishing Shop: Tidy Up is a relaxing first-person game where you bring order to a messy fishing shop. Pick up scattered items, sort them by category, color, and size, place them on the right shelves, upgrade your abilities, and choose music to match your mood!
5438730.name: Fishing Shop: Tidy Up

5439420.desc: Embark on your adventure with player from all over the world! Lead your Angel team to reveal the ancient mysteries of Galaxy…… Welcome to Angel legion, a free RPG gacha game with good fun!
5439420.name: Angel Legion-DLC Starlit Veil Dance (Orange)

5440370.desc: Command a customizable cat in this 3D tower defense game. Build elemental cannons, research new defenses, deploy cat-piloted aircraft, and repel waves of mice. Face bosses, tackle daily sieges, and create and share maps through Steam Workshop.
5440370.name: Meowstone Siege

5444340.desc: The Claw and Conjure demo is an async PvP auto-battler with fantasy RPG units. Upgrade your town to synergize with your build, then race into battle against real players. The demo offers free access to early game units, items, and abilities and allows PvP play for 8 rounds per run
5444340.name: Claw and Conjure Demo

5444410.desc: Battle enemy hordes, build powerful ability combinations, and defeat challenging bosses in this single-player bullet heaven roguelike. Choose distinct characters, unlock evolutions, and earn permanent upgrades—all with offline gameplay.
5444410.name: Dungeon Survivor

5444950.desc: Collect spinning tops, mix parts and take on rivals and tournaments! Run your own top shop, team up with friends in online co-op, or bring your custom build into a 1v1 battle.
5444950.name: Topsmith: Spinning Top Shop Simulator

5446260.desc: Immerse yourself in the nostalgic atmosphere of early 2000s Russia as you investigate the theft of a city relic. Interact with unique characters, make difficult decisions, and find your path. Save your hometown or feed it to the fiends.
5446260.name: Lestvitsa

5449250.desc: A block-stacking puzzle game for friends. Drop pieces onto one shared board that grows with your group, clear lines together, draft perks and survive random events. Or battle in team duels up to 4v4 and free-for-all matches for up to 10 players. Plus a 40-level campaign.
5449250.name: Quadora

5449940.desc: Furry Witch Fox is a cozy Halloween furry clicker starring an adorable fox witch! Collect hearts, buy upgrades, catch ghosts, and unlock 45 colorful illustrations. Pumpkins, candles, and the comforting magic of Halloween await!
5449940.name: Furry Witch Fox

5451120.desc: Recruit Three Kingdoms heroes and build a five-unit team. Combine faction synergies, merge heroes, and use equipment and stratagems to prepare for automatic battles. Every shop visit and formation choice shapes your run through an ink-painted age of conflict.
5451120.name: Three Kingdoms: Gambit of Chaos

5451960.desc: Demo of CHU: The Nightmare of That Day. Long after your discharge, you wake up back in the barracks: live through Day 1 and the first night with “him” still awake, then take on spin-off Chapter 1, The Silent Monastery, in 1-4 player online co-op. The full game launches January 14, 2027.
5451960.name: 추 : 그날의 악몽 Demo

5455560.desc: Ten fortresses, one river, five against five. Build your base, train an army of up to a hundred units and break the enemy HQs with your team in fast real-time strategy battles. Free to play, with cross-play between PC, iPhone and Android.
5455560.name: Command Base Assault

5460060.desc: Commander, sixteen enemy officers stand between your armoured train and the end of the war. Beat them in card battles and they join your squad. Pour the whiskey in your quarters to unlock their animated scenes, uncensored. One purchase. No microtransactions.
5460060.name: Debriefed : Frontline Command

5461870.desc: A first-person sci-fi social deduction game for up to 8 players. Fix the ship, watch your crewmates, then accuse and vote out the infected. Or be Patient 0: lie, sabotage and vanish. A co-op mode swaps the traitor for a hunter and a ticking clock.
5461870.name: Synthetic Quorum

5463460.desc: VELTARUM is a single-player retro FPS built around fast movement and brutal combat. Wall-run through a dark world of towers and chains, fight with guns and a sword, slow time, and face towering bosses. Spend crystals on upgrades between lives and climb again.
5463460.name: Veltarum

5465850.desc: High-speed anti-gravity racing across 16 tracks. Take on 15 rivals, master banked corners, loops and jumps, and spend your energy on perfectly timed boosts. Unlock 12 distinct ships and compete for victory across four Grand Prix cups.
5465850.name: FLUX CIRCUIT

5465870.desc: Stack zombies, clear lines, and chase high scores! Zombie Mori! is a fast-paced falling-block puzzle game packed with quirky zombies! Clear multiple lines, combine zombie types for huge score multipliers, and unlock all 50 zombies in your collection. The higher you stack, the higher you score!
5465870.name: ゾンビ盛り！

5466110.desc: Free Issue 00 includes an exclusive special stage of the wild run & gun HIJURA SCARLET GEAR! A disk-magazine-style collection of indie studio HU-GA's work, also with the Final Re:Quest movie trailer in TRUE PIXEL, a special booklet and four Zolge Station talk specials. New issues arrive as DLC.
5466110.name: ZOLGE STATION: HUGA Waiwai Academy

5469310.desc: Start with an empty account and load the first cargo yourself. Hire and train workers, add wagons and expand your station and warehouse. In this railway idle game, watch the flow of goods, spot bottlenecks and decide which upgrade will make the biggest difference.
5469310.name: Haste Makes Waste

5471970.desc: An endless pile of paperwork is waiting for your approval stamp. Reject shameless "business expenses," outwork your rivals, and from New Hire to Chairman, work until the day you die!
5471970.name: Rubber Stamp Legend

5471990.desc: You watched the defragmenter as a kid. Now it's your turn. Sweep the read head across scrambled disks, hear fragments click into place, and upgrade your machine from a 1998 floppy to a 2032 archive array, recovering thirty years of one ordinary life along the way.
5471990.name: Disk Defragmenter

5472000.desc: Your grandpa is giving you his old farm! Clean it up, plant vegetables, take care of the animals, and make friends in the small village of Lindenau. Go fishing, explore caves, and help the village fight back against a big scheme from the city. Play alone or with up to 3 friends.
5472000.name: Cloverstead

5472080.desc: SHRED A BILLION is a first-person incremental game about a mountain of money! Grab bills by hand, scoop them with a bucket, level up and feed a billion dollars to the shredder. Only 3,929,120,202 bills left to go!
5472080.name: SHRED A BILLION

5472270.desc: The most emotionally charged horror game. Find all the pictures before the entities find you.
5472270.name: Backrooms Found Hentai

5472580.desc: A large-scale sorting simulator set in a two-storey hypermarket: organize 65,146 products and boxes across 23 departments, stock shelves and warehouse racks, and use boosters to find, carry and place items.
5472580.name: Hypermarket: Sort & Stock

5473910.desc: A turn-based RPG about hamster cosmonauts. Roaches hired by space pirates have stolen the Golden Sunflower. Lead five heroes through 170 levels in five worlds, beat the bosses and bring the petals home.
5473910.name: Space Hamsters

5474650.desc: A minimalistic, top down, survival horror. Run, strategise and outplay The Horror accross multiple maps and modes.
5474650.name: The Horror

5475240.desc: Explore a shifting fantasy world in Riftgrove, a 3D action RPG featuring four playable classes, fast-paced combat, procedurally generated wilderness, dangerous dungeons, rare relics, and powerful Champions. Return to Haven, take guild contracts, and venture through the next portal.
5475240.name: RIFTGROVE

5476770.desc: Armed Prisoner III is a 2D casual incremental idle electronic cricket small game in which the core gameplay revolves around Bot AI characters using modern firearms to shoot and fight each other. The battles are random, chaotic, and unlimited in duration
5476770.name: Armed Prisoner III

5477320.desc: Break the support. Drop the slab. Smash the rock below. Rockburst is an incremental mining game about setting off collapses, collecting ore and buying upgrades to dig deeper before your lamp runs out.
5477320.name: Rockburst

5477930.desc: Your cat borrowed eight million, built a second sun in the bathroom, and named you guarantor. An absurd comedy visual novel with dubious contracts, a bathtub republic, a turn-based solar puzzle, and three ways to survive the evening.
5477930.name: Boris & the Second Sun

5482540.desc: Conduct an orchestra with your mouse as the baton. The catch: they're terrible. The flute can't be heard, the horn is deafening, and the choir in Beethoven's Ninth only sings "Aaah". Had enough? Throw the baton at them. Instruments break, the damage piles up, and they throw it back.
5482540.name: MISCONDUCTOR | 迷指揮者

5484400.desc: A relaxing first-person sim about tidying up a forgotten military underground base. Shelve ammo crates, weapons, drones and gear, unlock new sectors and level up your skills – solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. No timers, no pressure.
5484400.name: Military Base Tidy Up

5486000.desc: A couch co-op spellcaster for one to four players. Aim every spell by hand, jump what you cannot walk around, and read fifteen bespoke bosses well enough not to burn your friends. Friendly fire is always on.
5486000.name: Emberveth

5486980.desc: A solo card game with one deck. Clubs and spades are monsters. Diamonds are weapons. Hearts are potions. Each round deals 4 cards: play 3, keep 1. Get through the deck alive. Every deck can be won. A new daily deck every day, and rogue runs of six decks.
5486980.name: Grim Deck

5487470.desc: A first-person multiplayer social deduction game: investigate, craft equipment and expose the parasite, or play as the creature to hide inside other players, take control of their bodies and turn their trust against them.
5487470.name: Parasite: Among the Guests

5488250.desc: Hunt zombies, collect powerful loot, and grow stronger in this third-person action RPG. Find pistols, assault rifles, shotguns, and equipment with randomized stats and effects, build your character, fight through five increasingly dangerous stages, and ultimately challenge the Zomking.
5488250.name: Zomking

5490440.desc: SKY REAVER is a pixel-art vertical shoot 'em up with incremental progression. Dodge bullets, destroy enemies and collect resources. Return to base for permanent upgrades, unlock missiles, wingmen and lasers, and take on 25 powerful bosses with ever-growing firepower.
5490440.name: SKY REAVER

5490870.desc: Change gravity in six directions and guide crystal orbs to their goals in this single-player 3D puzzle game. Choose any of 100 stages from the start. EXTRA HARD adds XOR gates, water controls and floating platforms in larger mazes. Team up with Meguru and Bimba to earn minimum-move medals!
5490870.name: Horochi's Challenge

5493320.desc: Supporter pack with the Grimguard Armor, Chaos Glider and matching cape cosmetics
5493320.name: Stormforge - Supporter Pack Cosmetics

5494940.desc: Turn a forgotten mountain street into a cozy yokai night bazaar. Gather ingredients, choose stalls, and let an odd little crew get to work. Keep recipes between runs, learn lasting upgrades, and prepare seven lantern-lit festivals.
5494940.name: Yokai Night Bazaar

5496540.desc: Heavy punches, big bellies and scores to settle. Street Panz is a single-player 2D fighting game: choose from eight fighters, take on the neighborhood rivals and four bosses, sharpen your moves and climb the local leaderboard.
5496540.name: Street Panz

5498450.desc: inFADErs is a barbershop simulator where every hair on your customer's head is real. Thousands of strands grow, fall, flop when wet and stand up when dry, and every one of them is judged when the cut is done.
5498450.name: inFADErs

550.desc: Set in the zombie apocalypse, Left 4 Dead 2 is a co-operative action horror FPS takes you and your friends through the cities, swamps and cemeteries of the Deep South, from Savannah to New Orleans across five expansive campaigns.
550.name: Left 4 Dead 2

5500200.desc: The companion that turns your next battle around might still be inside an egg—hatch your team, brave dice-driven turn-based battles, and journey from sunlit shores to snowy wilds and distant star realms.
5500200.name: Dicekin: Monster Tamer

5502740.desc: Mastering your skills at Chess has never been easier or more fun. Earn gold by challenging yourself in both full games of chess against 20 different NPC opponents, each with their own personalities & quirks, or in 150+ puzzles. Take your gold and wager it online or in an intense dungeon adventure!
5502740.name: Dungeons of Chesslore

5505730.desc: A top-down arcade drift game. Flick into slides, link corners into massive combos and chase medals across neon cities, snowy passes and desert canyons. Customize your car with 230+ parts, beat daily challenges, or cruise a living city in the Chill Zone.
5505730.name: Drift: Beyond Grip

550650.desc: Black Squad is a free-to-play military first-person-shooter. Players can master their skills and show off their strategies with a wide range of game maps, modes, and weapons to choose from. Join thousands of FPS players worldwide in one of the most played games on Steam!
550650.name: Black Squad

5507590.desc: A language-learning reader for your own books. Import EPUB, PDF and TXT files, then just read: Errant Ant counts every word you meet and look up, and colors each one by how well you really know it, so new words stand out and familiar ones fade. No flashcards, no account.
5507590.name: Errant Ant

5508260.desc: Reveal Chess: hidden pieces, logic & tactics. Flip Chess: 4×8 board, Cannon & 60 HP. Classic chess too. Online matchmaking, friend battles, 8 languages.
5508260.name: Reveal & Flip Chess

5510420.desc: A comedy of terrors begins in The Fog. Dead by Daylight: Terrifier brings horror icons The Terrifier and Sienna Shaw into The Fog alongside a new original Map, Hartshorne Mall. Purchasing this add-on unlocks the Art Crispies Cereal charm and the Clown Cafe Banner.
5510420.name: Dead by Daylight: Terrifier

5513550.desc: A coin-flip incremental. Hover over coins and they flip on their own. Buy more coins, a bigger ring and chain reactions until the whole stone is exploding in gold. Pay off Hell's bills before they're due, or lose it all.
5513550.name: Obol

5513610.desc: A top-down survivors-like where your ship's neon trail is your only attack. Circle a swarm, close the loop, and everything inside bursts at once. Bigger loops hit harder but keep you exposed for longer. A run takes about ten minutes.
5513610.name: LOOPLINE

552990.desc: Immerse yourself in thrilling naval battles and assemble an armada of over 800 ships from the first half of the 20th century — from stealthy destroyers to gigantic battleships. Change the look of your ship, choose upgrades to suit your play style, and go into battle with other players!
552990.name: World of Warships

553850.desc: The Galaxy’s Last Line of Offence. Enlist in the Helldivers and join the fight for freedom across a hostile galaxy in a fast, frantic, and ferocious third-person shooter.
553850.name: HELLDIVERS™ 2

5542670.desc: Support Safari-TV and give your next questionable expedition a new look. Includes the Reptile Skin, Monkey Costume, Alien Goggles and Hypnotic Glasses. Cosmetic items only.
5542670.name: Safari-TV - Supporter Pack

5542680.desc: Bring a little more nonsense to your next safari with the Lion Costume, Black Robber Mask and Pixel Glasses. Three cosmetic items for the friends who always end up in the footage.
5542680.name: Safari-TV - Community Pack

5549700.desc: Return to an abandoned psychiatric hospital where your mother vanished twenty years ago. Explore dark corridors, solve environmental puzzles, and survive terrifying encounters in this 25–30 minute first-person psychological horror demo. Room 307 is waiting.
5549700.name: ROOM 307 Demo

5550010.desc: A dark fantasy roguelike auto-battler where massive armies clash as rival gods shape your campaign with blessings, curses, and impossible demands.
5550010.name: Bring Me More! Demo

570.desc: Every day, millions of players worldwide enter battle as one of over a hundred Dota heroes. And no matter if it's their 10th hour of play or 1,000th, there's always something new to discover. With regular updates that ensure a constant evolution of gameplay, features, and heroes, Dota 2 has taken on a life of its own.
570.name: Dota 2

578080.desc: PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS, the high-stakes winner-take-all shooter that started the Battle Royale craze, is free-to-play! Drop into diverse maps, loot unique weapons and supplies, and survive in an ever-shrinking zone where every turn could be your last.
578080.name: PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS

582010.desc: Welcome to a new world! In Monster Hunter: World, the latest installment in the series, you can enjoy the ultimate hunting experience, using everything at your disposal to hunt monsters in a new world teeming with surprises and excitement.
582010.name: Monster Hunter: World

594650.desc: Hunt: Showdown 1896 is the brutally rewarding extraction shooter. Track twisted monsters and overcome ruthless PvP. Take bounties in corrupted backwaters lost to history. With a team, you might survive. Die with nothing or get out with everything.
594650.name: Hunt: Showdown 1896

60.desc: A futuristic action game that challenges your agility as well as your aim, Ricochet features one-on-one and team matches played in a variety of futuristic battle arenas.
60.name: Ricochet

6100.desc: Eets may have a cute outer-shell, but its Lemmings meets The Incredible Machine gameplay, crazy characters and over 100 increasingly tricky puzzles quickly sucks in even the most seasoned player.
6100.name: Eets

620.desc: The "Perpetual Testing Initiative" has been expanded to allow you to design co-op puzzles for you and your friends!
620.name: Portal 2

6220.desc: Ram through pile-ups and smash through your windshield as you push racing to the edge! FlatOut™ delivers more heart-stopping thrills than any sane driver can handle!
6220.name: FlatOut

629520.desc: Play sounds in voice chats in high digital quality. Add sounds or music to your microphone signal so others will hear it, too.
629520.name: Soundpad
